Chop the broccoli, stems and all, into coarse florets and add them to the pot. Stir and cook until just softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the white wine vinegar, then add the vegetable broth and coconut milk. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.

Let the soup cool slightly, then transfer to a blender (you can work in batches if you need to). Blend until smooth. Add the amaranth greens and blend again. Taste and adjust the seasonings, adding a bit of lemon juice to brighten it up a bit if you like.
Garnish with a drizzle of coconut milk and olive oil. Sprinkle with red pepper flakes, if desired.

name: Sweet Chili Charred Broccolini
note: Also good with roasted brussel sprouts, sweet potatoes, or eggplant.
preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 400℉ and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a small bowl, whisk together the tamarind, minced garlic, rice vinegar, sugar, sriracha, and red pepper flakes.

Place the broccolini on the baking sheet and toss with half of the sauce, then spread the broccolini evenly so that the pieces are not touching each other. Roast for 15 minutes, or until the broccolini is charred on the edges. Serve with the remaining sauce on the side for dipping.

name: Brussels Sprout Breakfast Tostadas

ingredients.rawIngredient: Extra-virgin olive oil, for brushing and drizzling
ingredients.name: Extra-virgin olive oil, for brushing and drizzling

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 cup cooked black beans, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: cooked black beans

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Brush the tortillas with olive oil and toast in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side, or until crispy. Or bake in the oven at 300℉ for 10 to 15 minutes, or until crispy. Remove and set aside.

Add a drizzle of olive oil to the skillet and place the shredded brussels sprouts in a thin layer with a pinch of salt and pepper. Use tongs to flip the shredded brussels sprouts as they brown. Remove them from the pan once they’re lightly golden brown, about 4 minutes.
In a nonstick skillet, fry the eggs until the whites are set and the yolks are still runny.

Use the back of a fork to smash a quarter of the avocado onto each tortilla and add a squeeze of lime juice and a pinch of salt. Assemble each tortilla with the brussels sprouts, black beans, eggs, radishes, and pepper. Serve with hot sauce, if desired.

name: Shredded Brussels Sprout & Cranberry Salad

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil, plus extra for drizzling
ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil, plus extra for drizzling

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Thinly slice the brussels sprouts using a mandoline if you have one. Place them into a medium bowl and toss with the olive oil, lemon juice, pine nuts, cranberries, pecorino cheese, chives, and pinches of salt and pepper.
Let the salad sit at room temp for 15 minutes, then taste and adjust the seasonings. Finish with an additional drizzle of olive oil if you like.

name: Vegan Carrot Waffles
note: Yields 4 to 6 waffles

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 cups whole spelt flour or white/wheat mix
ingredients.name: whole spelt flour or white/wheat mix

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 cups almond milk at room temp
ingredients.name: almond milk at room temp

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 tbsp maple syrup, plus extra for serving
ingredients.name: maple syrup, plus extra for serving

preparationSteps: Preheat a waffle iron.
In a large bowl, mix the flour, baking powder, flaxseed, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt.
In a medium bowl, mix together the grated carrots, almond milk, coconut oil, vanilla, and maple syrup. Fold the carrot mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Scoop an appropriate amount of batter onto your waffle iron and cook until the edges are slightly crisp. Serve with maple syrup and the coconut cream, if using.

name: Coconut Cream
note: Variations: Add 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1/2 tsp lemon zest, or a few drops of lemon oil.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 (14-ounce) cans full-fat coconut milk, refrigerated overnight
ingredients.name: full-fat coconut milk, refrigerated overnight

preparationSteps: Remove the coconut milk from the fridge and carefully scoop the thick solid part off the top. Save the watery part for another use. Use an electric mixer to whip the coconut cream until fluffy, 3 to 5 minutes. Add the powdered sugar and vanilla and mix again.

name: Carrot Ribbon Tacos

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 1/2 cups cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: cooked chickpeas

ingredients.rawIngredient: Few handfuls of cilantro leaves, stems reserved
ingredients.name: Few handfuls of cilantro leaves, stems reserved

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Preheat the broiler of your oven, and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the chickpeas with a drizzle of olive oil, garlic, cumin, and pinches of salt and pepper. Broil for 3 to 5 minutes, or until the chickpeas are slightly golden brown.
Peel the carrots into ribbons and set aside.

Make the cilantro-stem yogurt sauce: In a food processor, pulse the yogurt, cilantro stems, scallions, garlic, coriander, lime juice, and pinches of salt and pepper. With the food processor running, drizzle in the olive oil. Taste and adjust the seasonings. If it’s too tart, add a bit of honey if you’d like. Chill until ready to use.
Fill each tortilla with the yogurt sauce, chickpeas, mango, radishes, carrot ribbons, cilantro, and serrano pepper, if using.
Serve with the sriracha on the side

name: Carrot-Ginger Grain Bowl
note: Makes a lot of leftovers.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 8 ounces extra-firm tofu, cut into cubes
ingredients.name: extra-firm tofu

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 400℉.
Use a vegetable peeler to peel 3 carrots into ribbions. Save any leftover carrot pieces for roasting.

Line two baking sheets with parchment paper. Cut the remaining 7 carrots vertically in quarters and arrange on the first baking sheet along with any leftover carrot pieces. Place the tofu cubes on the second baking sheet. Toss the carrots and tofu cubes with a drizzle of olive oil, and season with salt and pepper. Bake for 15 to 17 minutes, or until golden brown around the edges. The carrots should still have some bite to them.
Remove the tofu from the oven, toss it lightly with sriracha, and return it to the oven for 2 more minutes.
Toss the salad greens with the cooked millet, carrot greens, almonds, a third of the carrot-ginger sauce, and a few pinches of salt.
Assemble the bowls with the millet salad, roasted carrots, carrot ribbons, tofu, avocado, and pepper. Serve with the remaining carrot-ginger sauce on the side.

name: Carrot-Ginger Sauce

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: In a blender, puree the carrots with the garlic, olive oil, tahini, lemon juice, ginger, and orange juice. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Carrot & Tomato Tagliatelle

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 cup cooked cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: cooked cannellini beans

ingredients.rawIngredient: Chopped chives or other herbs (basil, parsley, etc)
ingredients.name: Chopped chives or other herbs (basil, parsley, etc)

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the shallot and a pinch of salt and pepper and cook until soft, about 2 minutes. Add the carrots, garlic, oregano, red pepper flakes, and another few pinches of salt. Let cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are lightly browned, about 5 minutes.

Add the white wine. Stir and let the wine cook off until it’s nearly evaporated, about 30 seconds. Add the balsamic vinegar and tomatoes. Cover and reduce the heat to a simmer. Cook until the carrots are tender, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Prepare the pasta according to the instructions on the package, cooking until al dente. Drain the pasta.

Stir the chopped kale into the sauce and let it wilt down, about 1 minute. Add the pasta, cannellini beans, pine nuts, capers, and chives or herbs. Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve with freshly grated Parmesan cheese, if desired

name: Roasted Cauliflower & Red Pepper Soup

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 small head cauliflower, cut into florets
ingredients.name: cauliflower

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 cup raw unsalted cashews, soaked 3 to 4 hours, preferably overnight
ingredients.name: raw unsalted cashews, soaked 3 to 4 hours, preferably overnight

ingredients.rawIngredient: 3 roasted red bell peppers, fresh or from a jar
ingredients.name: roasted red bell peppers, fresh or from a jar

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tsp sherry vinegar or white white vinegar (optional)
ingredients.name: sherry vinegar or white white vinegar (optional)

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 400℉.

Line two baking sheets with parchment paper. Fill one sheet with the cauliflower florets and the other with the sliced onion and garlic cloves. Drizzle both sheets with olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss to combine. Roast 20 to 30 minutes, until golden brown. Check at 20 minutes, as the onion might roast faster than the cauliflower. Reserve 1 cup of the roasted florets for garnish.

Drain and rinse the cashews and place them in a high-speed blender. Peel the roasted garlic cloves and add them to the blender with the cauliflower, onion, miso paste, fresh water, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, and roasted red bell peppers. Blend until creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. For extra brightness, add a splash of sherry vinegar or white wine vinegar.
Garnish with a drizzle of olive oil and the reserved roasted cauliflower.

name: Curried Cauliflower Fried Rice

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 to 3 cups cauliflower florets, crumbled into small pieces
ingredients.name: cauliflower florets, crumbled into small pieces

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 cup cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed (pg 285)
ingredients.name: cooked chickpeas

ingredients.rawIngredient: 3/4 cup canned full-fat or light coconut milk
ingredients.name: canned full-fat or light coconut milk

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Cook the rice according to the directions on page 284. Set aside.
Make the cardamom yogurt sauce: In a small bowl, combine the yogurt, lime juice, cardamom, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Chill until ready to serve.

In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat. Add the shallots, cauliflower, and pinches of salt and pepper. Cook until the cauliflower is lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Add the cashews and chickpeas and cook until lightly browned, about 5 more minutes.

Add the curry powder, turmeric, red pepper flakes, and scallions. Stir and cook until the spices are fragrant, about 30 seconds. Reduce the heat and add 1/2 cup of the coconut milk. Then add the lime juice, currants, and another pinch of salt. Add the rice and stir to incorporate, breaking up any clumpy rice grains. Add the remaining 1/4 cup coconut milk and stir in the mint. Season to taste.
Serve with the cardamom yogurt sauce.

name: Grapefruit, Quinoa & Fennel Salad with Mint

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 small fennel bulb, white part, thinly sliced
ingredients.name: small fennel bulb, white part

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: In a large bowl, combine the sliced fennel, watermelon radish, olive oil, lemon juice, white wine vinegar, honey, grapefruit segments, and a few pinches of salt and pepper.
Toss to combine, then add the salad greens, quinoa, feta cheese, pine nuts, and mint. Toss again. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

name: Corn, Tomato, & Mozzarella Salad

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for brushing
ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for brushing

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup small fresh mozzarella balls, sliced in half
ingredients.name: small fresh mozzarella balls, sliced in half

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Brush the corn with olive oul and grill, about 2 minutes per side, rotating until the kernels on all sides are tender and a few char marks form, about 10 minutes. Let cool, then slice the kernels off the cobs.

Place the corn in a large bowl with the spinach, tomatoes, mozzarella, scallions, and basil. Toss with 1 tsp of olive oil, the sherry vinegar, and smoked paprika, if using. Season generously with salt and pepper.

name: Grilled Mexican Corn Salad

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 tbsp adobo sauce from canned chipotles in adobo sauce
ingredients.name: adobo sauce from canned chipotles in adobo sauce

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/3 cup crumbled cotija or feta cheese
ingredients.name: crumbled cotija or feta cheese

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/3 cup chopped cilantro, plus a few sprigs for garnish
ingredients.name: chopped cilantro, plus a few sprigs for garnish

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Brush the corn with the olive oil and grill, about 2 minutes per side, rotating it until the kernels on all sides are tender and a few char marks form, about 10 minutes.

Remove the corn from the heat and brush with the adobo sauce. Use a knife to slice the kernels off the cob. Toss with the crumbled cheese, cilantro, lime juice, and salt and pepper to taste. Add cilantro sprigs to garnish.

name: Spicy Cornbread
note: This recipe can also be made in mini-skillet pans or muffin cups: For eight 3.5-inch mini-skillets bake 18 to 20 minutes and for a 12-cup muffin tin, bake for 15 to 18 minutes.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup spelt flour or all-purpose flour
ingredients.name: spelt flour or all-purpose flour

ingredients.rawIngredient: 3/4 cup unsweetened almond milk, at room temp
ingredients.name: unsweetened almond milk, at room temp

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 cup melted coconut oil, plus more for drizzling
ingredients.name: melted coconut oil, plus more for drizzling

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 350℉.
In a large bowl, stir together the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. In a medium bowl, whisk together the almond milk, maple syrup, coconut oil, and apple cider vinegar.
Pour the wet ingredients into the bowl with the dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Fold in the corn kernels and sliced serrano peppers. Don’t overmix.
Brush a 10-inch cast-iron skillet with a drizzle of coconut oil. Spread the batter into the skillet and bake for 20 to 22 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Cool for 15 minutes before serving.

name: Green Gazpacho

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 large English cucumber, chopped (reserve 1/2 cup for garnish)
ingredients.name: large English cucumber, chopped (reserve 1/2 cup for garnish)

ingredients.rawIngredient: 6 small to medium yellow tomatoes, quartered, with juices
ingredients.name: small to medium yellow tomatoes, quartered, with juices

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for drizzling
ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for drizzling

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tsp honey or raw cane sugar (optional)
ingredients.name: honey or raw cane sugar (optional)

preparationSteps: In a blender, combine the cucumber, tomatoes, scallions, garlic, cilantro, sherry vinegar, olive oil, sunflower seeds, and serrano pepper, if using. Blend until smooth and season to taste. Depending on the sweetness of your tomatoes, you may want to add a drizzle of honey or a few pinches of sugar. Chill for at least 30 minutes.
Garnish the soup with the reserved chopped cucumbers and a drizzle of oilve oil

name: Cucumber Basil & Watermelon Salad

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 English cucumber, chopped into 1/2-inch pieces (just over 2 cups)
ingredients.name: English cucumber, chopped into 1/2-inch pieces (just over 2 cups)

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 ripe mango, skin removed and chopped into 1/2-inch pieces
ingredients.name: ripe mango, skin removed and chopped into 1/2-inch pieces

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 cup salted peanuts, crushed and toasted
ingredients.name: salted peanuts, crushed and toasted

preparationSteps: In a large bowl, whisk together the tamarind, garlic, ginger, lime juice, and rice vinegar.
Add the watermelon, cucumber, mango, serrano pepper, cilantro, and basil. Chill for 30 minutes. Drain a little of the excess liquid before serving.
Serve with the crushed peanuts on top.

name: Cold Sesame Cucumber Noodles

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 tbsp tamari, plus more to taste
ingredients.name: tamari, plus more to taste

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil, plus more for drizzling
ingredients.name: toasted sesame oil, plus more for drizzling

preparationSteps: In a large bowl, whisk together the rice vinegar, tamarind, sesame oil, peanut butter, garlic, and ginger. Stir in the scallions.

Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Prepare the noodles according to the instructions on the package, cooking until al dente. Drain, then chill the noodles in a bowl of ice water for about 1 minute. Drain, then add the noodles to the large bowl.
Add the cucumber and toss to combine. Add the snap peas, tofu, and additional vegetables, if using.
Season with more tamari, to taste. Finish with a drizzle of sesame oil and sprinkle with the sesame seeds. Chill until ready to searve.

name: Crispy Baked Eggplant

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 large eggplant, sliced 1/4 inch thick (12 to 17 slices)
ingredients.name: large eggplant, sliced 1/4 inch thick (12 to 17 slices)

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 400℉.
Pat dry the eggplant and lay on paper towels. Sprinkle with salt and let sit while you prep everything else. Pat dry occasionally.

Make the breading: In a food processor, pulse the hemp seeds, nutritional yeast, sunflower seeds, garlic, panko, oregano, red pepper flakes, and pinches of salt and pepper. Transfer to a shallow bowl.
In another shallow bowl, whisk together the almond milk and cornstarch.
Drizle a 9 x 13 inch pan with olive oil. Add the tomatoes, drizzle with balsamic vinegar, and add pinches of salt and pepper. Spread to evenly coat the bottom of the pan.

Dip each eggplant slice in the almond milk, shake of any excess liquid, then dip in the breading mixture. Place in the pan on top of the tomatoes, allowing the eggplant slices to overlap slightly. Top with the pecorino cheese, a drizzle of olive oil, and the red pepper flakes. Bake, covered, for 15 minutes. Uncover and bake an additional 15 to 18 minutes, or until the eggplant is tender and the top is crispy.

name: Grilled Eggplant & Summer Veggie Pasta

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 red bell pepper, stem and ribs removed
ingredients.name: red bell pepper, stem and ribs removed

ingredients.rawIngredient: 8 ounces shell pasta or similar small shaped pasta
ingredients.name: shell pasta or similar small shaped pasta

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Heat a grill or grill pan to high heat.

Slice the eggplant vertically into 1-inch-thick planks. Slice the zucchini in half lengthwise. Slice the bell pepper vertically into 4 pieces. Drizzle the eggplant, zucchini, bell pepper, and whole mushrooms with olive oil and pinches of salt and pepper. Grill until all the vegetables are charred on both sides, 5 to 8 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Prepare the pasta according to the instructions on the package, cooking until al dente. Drain and place in a bowl.

Chop the eggplant, zucchini, and bell pepper into 1-inch pieces and slice the cremini mushrooms into quarters. Toss the vegetables with the pasta along with the pickled onions, basil, a pinch of pepper, and the red pepper flakes. Drizzle with the sherry vinegar and oregano and smoked paprika. Toss and season to taste. Serve with freshly grated Parmesan cheese if you like.

name: Quick Pickled Onions
preparationSteps: Cut the onion in half and use a mandoline, if you have one, to cut each half into thin slices. Place the sliced onion in a tight-lidded jar just large enough to hold all of the onion.

Add the white wine vinegar, cane sugar, and salt and shake gently. Add warm water so that it covers the onion and shake again. Gently pack the onion down into the jar and chill for at least 1 hour. Store in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.

name: Kale Salad #1
preparationSteps: Wash and dry the kale.
Remove the stems and tear the leaves into small pieces.
Drizzle with olive oil, a squeeze of lemon juice, and a pinch of sea salt.
Massage the leaves until they are soft and tender.
Add additional ingredients.

name: Kale Salad #2
preparationSteps: Wash and dry the kale.
Remove the stems and tear the leaves into small pieces.
Drizzle with olive oil, a squeeze of lemon juice, and a pinch of sea salt.
Massage the leaves until they are soft and tender.
Add the additional ingredients.

name: Kale Salad #3
preparationSteps: Wash and dry the kale.
Remove the stems and tear the leaves into small pieces.
Drizzle with olive oil, a squeeze of lemon juice, and a pinch of sea salt. Massage the leaves until they are soft and tender.
Add the additional ingredients.

name: Kale Salad #4
preparationSteps: Wash and dry the kale.
Remove the stems and tear the leaves into small pieces.
Drizzle with olive oil, a squeeze of lemon juice, and a pinch of sea salt.
Massage the leaves until they are soft and tender.
Add the additional ingredients.

name: Cashew & Caper Dill Spread
note: Yields 1 1/2 cups

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup raw unsalted cashews, soaked 3 to 4 hours, preferably overnight
ingredients.name: raw unsalted cashews, soaked 3 to 4 hours, preferably overnight

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 cup fresh dill, coarsely chopped; reserve a few for garnish
ingredients.name: fresh dill, coarsely chopped; reserve a few for garnish

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Drain and rinse the cashews and place them in a high-speed blender. Add the water, lemon juice, lemon zest, garlic, and olive oil. Puree until smooth. Add the capers and the dill. Season with salt and pepper and blend until well combined. Taste and adjust the seasonings. Chill until ready to serve.
Slather onto warm baguette slices and garnish with fresh dill and quick pickled onions, if desired.

name: Spring Onion Pizza

ingredients.rawIngredient: 6 to 10 thin spring onions or scallions, sliced into vertical strips
ingredients.name: thin spring onions or scallions, sliced into vertical strips

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup finely chopped herbs (a mix of basil, parsley, and tarragon)
ingredients.name: finely chopped herbs (a mix of basil, parsley, and tarragon)

preparationSteps: Prepare the homemade pizza dough.
Preheat the oven to 450℉.

On a lightly floured flat surface, divide the dough into 2 balls and roll each into a 10-inch oval shape. Add flour as needed to prevent sticking. Place the pizzas on a baking sheet sprinkled with cornmeal.

On a plate, toss the spring onions with a drizzle of balsamic vinegar. In a small bowl, mix the olive oil with the minced garlic and brush onto the dough. Top the pizza dough with the mozzarella slices and spring onion strips.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the onions are soft and the pizza crust  is golden brown.
Top the pizzas with the chopped herbs and a few pinches of red pepper flakes.

name: Quinoa Tacos with Quick Pickled Onions

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 1/2 cups cooked black beans, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: cooked black beans

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: In a medium skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the onion and pinches of salt and pepper. Cook until soft and lightly browned, 5 to 6 minutes. Add the garlic, cumin, and coriander and stir.
Add the quinoa and black beans and cook until warmed through, 2 more minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in the feta cheese and lime juice. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
FIll each tortilla with the quinoa/black bean mixture. Serve with the pickled onions, avocado, cilantro, and mango-basil salsa, if using.

name: Poblano Quesadillas
note: Can also try with roasted sweet potatoes, grilled mushrooms, roasted red peppers, zucchini, or black beans.

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Heat a cast-iron skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat. Place the peppers on the hot pan and use tongs to rotate them every few minutes until each side is lightly blackened. Alternatively, the peppers can be roasted under an oven broiler until charred. Remove the peppers from the heat, cut off the stems, remove the seeds, and dice.

Assemble each tortilla with the cheese, diced poblanos, spinach, pickled onions, and pinches of salt and pepper. Fold the tortillas in half and place in the hot skillet. Cook each side over medium heat for about 2 minutes, or until the tortillas are golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Toss the diced avocado with a squeeze of lime juice, a pinch of salt, and the cilantro. Serve on the side.

name: Roasted Red Pepper & Carrot Soup

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 roasted red bell pepper, fresh or from a jar
ingredients.name: roasted red bell pepper, fresh or from a jar

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 cup cooked cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: cooked cannellini beans

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 350℉.

Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and a pinch of salt and pepper and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic, fennel, carrots, and the thyme leaves. Stir and cook until the carrot edges begin to brown, about 10 minutes. Add the balsamic vinegar, bell pepper, cannellini beans, tomator paste, vegetable broth, and another few pinches of salt. Simmer until the carrots are tender, 15 to 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, make the croutouns: On a baking sheet, toss the bread cubes with a drizzle of olive oil and the garlic. Season with salt and pepper. Bake until crispy, 10 to 15 minutes.
Add the simmered soup to a high-speed blender (you ccan work in batches if you need to) and puree until smooth. Taste and adjust the seasonings.
Serve in bowls with a drizzle of olive oul and the croutons on top.

name: Red Pepper Feta Frittata

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 roasted red bell pepper, fresh or from a jar, chopped
ingredients.name: roasted red bell pepper, fresh or from a jar

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 400℉ with an 8-inch cast-iron skillet inside.
In a medium bowl, whisk the eggs with the almond milk and a few pinches of salt and pepper.

Using a pot holder, remove the preheated skillet from the oven and add the coconut oil to coat the bottom. Pour in the egg mixture, followed by the bell peppers, spinach, and feta cheese. Bake until the eggs are set and the frittata is golden brown on top, 15 to 20 minutes.
Remove the frittata from the oven, sprinkle with the red pepper flakes, and season with black pepper. Let cool slightly and serve.

name: Plum Pistachio Galette

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 pounds assorted purple or red plums
ingredients.name: assorted purple or red plums

ingredients.rawIngredient: White Cake Sparkles Edible Glitter, 0.25 oz.
ingredients.name: White Cake Sparkles Edible Glitter, 0.25 oz.

preparationSteps: In large bowl, stir together 1 1/2 cups flour and salt. Using pastry blender or fork, cut butter and shortening into flour until mixture resembles cornmeal. Add 3 tablespoons cold water and stir. If the dough is still dry, add additional water until mixture holds together in large clumps. Shape dough into a disc, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 375°F. Line cookie pan with parchment paper. Roll dough to a 12-inch circle, about 1/8 inch thick and transfer to pan.

In large bowl, toss plums, sugar, cinnamon, lemon juice, zest and 1 tablespoon flour until well combined. Spoon plum mixture over dough, leaving a 2 inch border around the edges. Sprinkle pistachios over the filling. Fold edge of dough over fruit filling, pleating together every few inches. Brush edges of dough with egg wash, and sprinkle with Wilton Sparkling Sugar. Bake 45-55 minutes or until crust is golden and fruit juices begin to bubble. Cool to room temperature on cooling grid.
In a small bowl, heat apricot preserves and water in microwave for 10 second intervals until very warm, stirring until smooth. Brush over plums.

name: Confetti Cookies
note: Recipe barely adapted from King Arthur, technique and language were tinkered with

ingredients.rawIngredient: 3/4 teaspoon fine sea or table salt
ingredients.name: fine sea or table salt

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup (8 ounces, 225 grams or 2 sticks) unsalted butter
ingredients.name: unsalted butter

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 cup (2 ounces, 55 grams or 1/4 of an 8-ounce brick) cream cheese
ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.quantity: 1/4 cup (2 ounces, 55 grams or 1/4 of an 8-ounce brick)

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 teaspoons vanilla extract or 1/2 a vanilla bean, split and scraped (see Note up top)
ingredients.name: vanilla extract or 1/2 a vanilla bean, split and scraped (see Note up top)

preparationSteps: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Line two baking large sheets with parchment paper.

To make in a food processor: Place flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt in the work bowl and pulse a few times to blend. Add butter and cream cheese in large chunks, plus sugar and blend until mixture is powdery. Add egg, vanilla and almond extracts and run machine until the dough balls together. You’ll probably need to scrape it down once or twice to get the mixture even.

To make with an electric mixer: Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a bowl and whisk to blend. In a large bowl or the bowl of a stand mixer, beat cream cheese, butter and sugar until fluffy. Add egg and extracts and blend again. Add flour mixture and beat just until flour disappears. In some cases, this dough will feel too soft to roll into balls in your hands; if so, let it chill in the fridge for 20 minutes or so before using.

Both methods: Scoop balls of dough — I like these cookies best with a #40, or 1 1/2 tablespoon, scoop; the texture is less dynamic when made smaller — and roll them briefly in the palms of your hands before dropping them in a bowl of rainbow sprinkles and gently rolling to coat them evenly. I find that the sprinkles adhere much better to tacky exterior of balls of dough that have been briefly warmed by your hands — trust me here.

Transfer balls of sprinkle-coated dough to baking sheets at least two inches apart. Use the bottom of a drinking glass to press down on the cookies until they are about 1/4 to 1/2-inch tall. If you see any bare spots in the sprinkles that bother you, you can sprinkle a few more on top. Bake for 9 to 10 minutes until they look underbaked but lightly golden underneath. [If they’re not quite soft in the center, they will be fully crisped through the next day.] Let set on the baking sheet on a rack for a few minutes before transferring to cooling racks to cool the rest of the way. Repeat with remaining cookie dough.

name: Blistered Padrón/Shishito Peppers
preparationSteps: Preheat a 10-inch or larger cast-iron skillet under the broiler, or at your oven’s highest temperature.
Once the skillet is hot, use a pot holder to remove it from the oven.
Place the peppers on the dry skillet and roast for 20 to 25 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden brown.
Remove the peppers from the oven, transfer to a plate, and drizzle with sesame oil. Add a pinch of salt and sprinkle with the sesame seeds.

name: Grilled Pepper & Quinoa Taco Salad

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 corn tortillas, sliced into thin strips
ingredients.name: corn tortillas, sliced into thin strips

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 1/2 cups cooked black beans, drained and rinsed (pg 285)
ingredients.name: cooked black beans

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tbsp fresh lime juice, plus more to taste
ingredients.name: fresh lime juice, plus more to taste

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 350℉. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Add the tortilla strips to the baking sheet and toss with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt. Bake for 12 minutes, or until crispy. Remove from the oven and set aside.

Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Place the peppers on the grill or grill pan and use tongs to rotate them every few minutes until each side is lighltly blackened, about 10 minutes. Remove the peppers from the heat and let cool for several minutes. Slice off the stems and remove any loose, blistered skin. Cut the peppers in half vertically, remove the seeds, and slice in 1/4-inch strips.
Make the dressing: In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lime juice, maple syrup, cumin, coriander, chili powder, and a pinch of salt and pepper.

Assemble the salad: In a large bowl, combine the peppers with the quinoa, black beans, radishes, cherry tomatoes, pipits, and jalapeño, if using. Pour the dressing over the salad. Gently mix in the avocado and top with the baked tortilla strips. Season with more salt, pepper, and lime juice to taste.
Serve with the chili-spiced yogurt and the lime slices.

name: Chili-Spiced Yogurt

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: In a small bowl, stir to combine.

name: Baked Eggs with Kale, Sage, & Sweet Potatoes

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 small sweet potato, chopped into 3/4-inch cubes
ingredients.name: small sweet potato, chopped into 3/4-inch cubes

ingredients.rawIngredient: Extra-virgin olive oil, for drizzling and brushing
ingredients.name: Extra-virgin olive oil, for drizzling and brushing

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 400℉. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

Spread the sweet potato cubes on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil, smoked paprika, and a pinch of salt and pepper and toss to combine. Roast until golden brown, about 25 minutes. Remove from the oven and reduce the oven heat to 300℉.

Brush the bottoms of two mini-skillets or ramekins with olive oil. Add the kale, sage, and roasted sweet potatoes. Crack 2 eggs on top of each skillet and sprinkle with feta cheese. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until the eggs have set but the yolks are still runny. Top with the chives and pinches of salt and pepper.

name: Curried Parsnip and White Bean Soup

ingredients.rawIngredient: 5 to 6 medium parsnips, peeled and chopped
ingredients.name: medium parsnips

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 Gala apple, peeled, cored, and chopped
ingredients.name: Gala apple, peeled, cored, and chopped

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 1/2 cups cooked cannellini beans, drained and rinsed, 1/4 cup reserved  for garnish
ingredients.name: cooked cannellini beans
ingredients.note: drained and rinsed, 1/4 cup reserved  for garnish

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion and a few generous pinches of salt and pepper and cook until soft, about 2 minutes.

Add the garlic and ginger and stir. Add the parsnips, apple, curry powder, cardamom, and cannellini beans. Stir and cook until the parsnips are lightly browned, about 2 minutes. Add the vegetable broth and simmer until the parsnips are tender, about 20 minutes.
Let the soup cool slightly, then transfer it to a blender (you can work in batches if you need to) and puree until creamy.
Season with more salt and pepper to taste. Garnish with the reserved cannellini beans and chopped chives.

name: Parsnip Fries with Red Pepper Hummus

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 1/2 cups cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: cooked chickpeas

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 roasted red bell pepper, fresh or from a jar
ingredients.name: roasted red bell pepper, fresh or from a jar

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 350℉. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.

Scrub the parsnips and slice into thin strips. Toss with a drizzle of olive oil and a few generous pinches of salt and pepper. Roast for 20 to 25 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden brown.

Make the red pepper hummus: In a food processor, combine the chickpeas, garlic, lemon juice, bell pepper, almonds, smoked paprika, olive oil, and pinches of salt and pepper. Blend until smooth. Add 2 to 3 tablespoons of warm water for a smooth consistency. Chill until ready to use.
Remove the parsnips from the oven, toss with the parsley, and serve with the red pepper hummus for dipping. They’re best served hot.

name: Vegan Tart Cherry French Toast

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 cup spelt or whole wheat flour
ingredients.name: spelt or whole wheat flour

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tbsp maple syrup, plus more for serving
ingredients.name: maple syrup, plus more for serving

ingredients.rawIngredient: 8 slices day old ciabatta bread, sliced about 3/4 inch thick
ingredients.name: day old ciabatta bread, sliced about 3/4 inch thick

preparationSteps: In a small bowl, whisk together the almond milk, flour, maple syrup, almond butter, nutritional yeast, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt.

Place the bread in a shallow baking dish that’s large enough to hold the bread in a single layer. Pour the almond milk mixture over the bread, then lift or flip the bread over to make sure both sides are evenly coated.

In a large skillet, heat a drizzle of coconut oil over medium heat. When the pan is hot, add the bread slices in a single layer and cook for a few minutes per side, or until golden brown. Repeat with any remaining slices.
Serve with the coconut cream, tart cherries, pomegranate seeds, and maple syrup.

name: Farm Stand Peach Pizzas

ingredients.rawIngredient: Fresh herbs (a few basil or oregano leaves)
ingredients.name: Fresh herbs (a few basil or oregano leaves)

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 350℉ and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

Assemble the pita bread or naan with the white cheddar cheese, zucchini, cherry tomatoes, peaches, and feta cheese. Bake until the cheese is golden brown and the peaches and zucchini are tender, about 15 minutes.
Remove from the oven, drizzle with olive oil, and top with the fresh herbs and red pepper flakes. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

name: Green Tomato Basil Grilled Cheese
note: White cheddar or smoked mozzarella cheese would also work well.

ingredients.rawIngredient: Extra-virgin olive oul, for brushing on bread
ingredients.name: Extra-virgin olive oul, for brushing on bread

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Slice the tomatoes into 1/4-inch slices. Set on a plate and season with salt and pepper.

Assemble 4 slices of bread with a slather of mustard and top with half of the cheese. Add 1 to 2 basil leaves, 2 to 3 tomato slices, and the remaining cheese. Top with the remaining slices of bread and brush both sides of the sandwich with olive oil.

Heat a grill pan or large skillet over medium heat. Grill the sandwiches about 5 minutes per side, or until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted, pressing down with a spatula or another pan to help melt the cheese.

name: Heirloom Tomato Panzanella with Fresh Oregano

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 pound heirloom tomatoes, cored and sliced into wedges
ingredients.name: heirloom tomatoes, cored and sliced into wedges

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for drizzling
ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for drizzling

ingredients.rawIngredient: 6 thick slices whole-grain bread or ciabatta bread
ingredients.name: thick slices whole-grain bread or ciabatta bread

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: In a large bowl, combine the tomatoes and the red onion slices with the sherry vinegar, olive oil, and pinches of salt and pepper.

Heat a grill or grill pan to medium heat. Drizzle the bread slices with olive oil and place on a hot grill. Cook 1 to 2 minutes on each side, until grill marks form. Remove from the heat and rub the warm grilled bread with the cut side of the garlic clove. Slice the bread into 1-inch cubes.

Place the bread cubes into the bowl with the tomatoes and onion. Add the basil, oregano, and a few pinches of salt and pepper, and toss to coat. Add a drizzle of olive oil, if desired. Let sit 10 minutes before serving.

name: Simple Fresh Tomato Sauce
note: Yields 3 cups. If you would like a smoother sauce, use a food mill to remove the seeds and skins before adding the tomatoes to the pot. Or blend the finished sauce.

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Heat a medium cast-iron skillet or grill pan over medium heat. Place the whole tomatoes on the hot skillet. Rotate every few minutes until nicely charred on all sides, the tomato skins start to break open, and the tomatoes have softened, 12 to 15 minutes. Transfer to a plate to cool, then remove the core of the tomatoes.

Heat the olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over low heat. Add the minced shallot, garlic, and pinches of salt and pepper and cook for about 3 minutes. Use your hands to crush the tomatoes in the pot, then use a masher to break them up more. Stir, then add the balsamic vinegar, sugar, and red pepper flakes.
Simmer over low heat for 20 minutes. Season with more salt and black pepper to taste.

name: Butternut Squash Red Curry

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup canned or fresh diced tomatoes
ingredients.name: canned or fresh diced tomatoes

ingredients.rawIngredient: 12 ounces extra-firm tofu, patted dry and cubed
ingredients.name: extra-firm tofu, patted dry and cubed

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: In a large pot over medium heat, heat 2 tbsp of coconut oil. Add the onion and season with a pinch of salt and pepper. Cook for about 5 minutes, then add the cubed butternut squash. Cook until the onion is soft and the butternut squash is beginning to brown around the edges, about 10 minutes.

Add the garlic and red curry paste and stir. Then add the tomatoes, coconut milk, and another pinch of salt. Stir, then reduce the heat to low. Simmer for 15 minutes, or until the butternut squash is tender.

Meanwhile, in a large skillet, heat the remaining 1 tbsp of coconut oil over medium heat. Add the cubed tofu in a single layer and sear each side for 1 to 2 minutes, or until golden brown, about 6 minutes total.
Add the spinach to the butternut squash curry and stir until wilted, 1 to 2 minutes. Add the lime juice and the seared tofu. Taste and adjust the seasonings.
Serve with quinoa.

name: Creamy Pumpkin Brown Rice Penne

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 kabocha or small sugar pie pumpkin (yield 1 heaping cup of cooked mash)
ingredients.name: kabocha or small sugar pie pumpkin (yield 1 heaping cup of cooked mash)

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 cup raw unsalted cashews, soaked for 3 to 4 hours, preferably overnight, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: raw unsalted cashews, soaked for 3 to 4 hours, preferably overnight

ingredients.rawIngredient: 16 ounces uncooked brown rice penne pasta
ingredients.name: uncooked brown rice penne pasta

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 350℉ and line a baking sheet with foil. Place the pumpkin, onion, and garlic on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Turn the pumpkin cut-side down and pierce a few holes in the skin with a fork. Cover and bake until the onion is soft and the pumpkin flesh is very tender, 35 to 45 minutes. Add the sage to the pan during the last few minutes. Remove the pan from the oven, keeping everything covered, and let it continue to steam for another 10 to 15 minutes.

Pour the vegetable broth into a blender. Remove the skin and add the pumpkin flesh to the blender along with the onion, peeled garlic, sage, cashews, and a few generous pinches of salt and pepper. Blend until creamy. Add the olive oil and blend again. Taste and adjust the seasonings, adding more salt and pepper if you like.
Prepare the pasta according to the instructions on the package, cooking until al dente.
Reserve 1/2 cup of pasta water before draining the pasta.

Drain the pasta and return it to the pot. Stir in half the sauce, adding more as needed to coat the pasta. Add the reserved pasta water, 1/4 cup at a time, to thin the sauce and make it creamy. Taste and season with more salt and pepper. Serve hot.

name: Butternut Squash Risotto & Arancini

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 recipe leftover butternut squash risotto, (makes about twelve 2-inch balls)
ingredients.name: recipe leftover butternut squash risotto, (makes about twelve 2-inch balls)

ingredients.rawIngredient: Simple fresh tomato sauce, or your favorite marinara sauce
ingredients.name: Simple fresh tomato sauce, or your favorite marinara sauce

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 ounces smoked mozzarella cheese, cut into twelve small cubes
ingredients.name: smoked mozzarella cheese

preparationSteps: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion and season with salt and pepper. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, then add the butternut squash and cook for 6 to 8 minutes. Add the garlic and the rice. Stir and let cook for about 1 minute. Season again with salt and pepper, then add the wine. Stir and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, or until the wine cooks down.

Add the vegetable broth, 3/4 cup at a time, stirring continuously, to allow each addition of broth to be absorbed before adding the next. Cook until the butternut squash is tender and the risotto is soft and creamy. Stir in the butter, Parmesan cheese, and fresh herbs. Season to taste and serve immediately. Save leftover risotto in the fridge for the arancini.

Make the arancini: Preheat the oven to 400℉ and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Remove the risotto from the fridge. Spread the panko on a large plate. Scoop 1 heaping tbsp of the risotto and use your hands to form a 2-inch ball. Place a piece of smoked mozzarella in the center, if using. Roll each ball in the panko and place on a baking sheet. Bake for 25 minutes or until golden brown and crispy. Serve with heated simple fresh tomato sauce.

name: Zucchini Lasagna with Zucchini “Ricotta"

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 375℉.

Make the zucchini “ricotta”: In a food processor, combine the walnuts, garlic, tofu, chopped zucchini, lemon juice, oregano, red pepper flakes, basil, and generous pinches of salt and pepper. Process to a spreadable consistency.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Prepare the pasta according to the instructions on the package, cooking until al dente. Drain and rinse.

Drizzle a 9 x 13 inch pan with olive oil, then layer the ingredients as follows. First layer: a third of the tomatoes, half of the noodles, half of the ricotta, half of the zucchini. Second layer: a third of the tomatoes, half of the noodles, half of the ricotta, half of the zucchini.
Top with the remaining third of the tomatoes. Sprinkle with the grated cheese and drizzle with olive oil.

Bake, covered, for 15 minutes. Uncover and bake 20 to 30 minutes, or until the zucchini is tender but still has a bite and the tomatoes and cheese are bubbling. Let rest for 10 minutes before serving. Season with freshly cracked black pepper.

name: Summer Squash & Cherry Tomato Pasta

ingredients.rawIngredient: 8 ounces capellini or brown rice spaghetti
ingredients.name: capellini or brown rice spaghetti

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Use a julienne peeler to slice the squash into long thin strips.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Prepare the pasta according to the instructions on the package, cooking until al dente. Drain the pasta.
Meanwhile, in a small skillet, heat a drizzle of olive oil over low heat. Add the tomatoes, garlic, fresh thyme, and pinches of salt and pepper. Cook until soft, about 3 minutes, turning as needed.
Toss the pasta with the squash, tomatoes, a drizzle of olive oil, the lemon juice, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Serve with your choice of toppings.

name: Summer Squash Succotash

ingredients.rawIngredient: 12 small pattypan squash, sliced in half or quartered (about 1 1/2 cups)
ingredients.name: small pattypan squash, sliced in half or quartered (about 1 1/2 cups)

ingredients.rawIngredient: 6 baby zucchini, chopped into 1/2-inch pieces (about 1 1/2 cups)
ingredients.name: baby zucchini, chopped into 1/2-inch pieces (about 1 1/2 cups)

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 cup cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: cooked chickpeas

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup cherry tomatoes, sliced in half
ingredients.name: cherry tomatoes, sliced in half

ingredients.rawIngredient: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Slice the kernels off the corn, then use the back of your knife to scrape the juices off of the corncob. Set aside.

Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and a pinch of salt and pepper. Let cook until soft, about 3 minutes, then add the bell papper and continue to cook for 2 more minutes, stirring occasionally.

Add the squash and zucchini, cut side down (as best you can), and another pinch of salt and pepper and cook for 5 minutes without moving them so they brown on one side. Stir in the chickpeas and cook for 2 more minutes. Stir in the corn, corn juices, and garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cherry tomatoes, scallion, and smoked paprika. Stir and cook 2 to 3 more minutes.
Turn off the heat and stir in the lemon juice and basil. Season to taste.

name: Effortless Vegan Overnight Oats
note: If your Vegan Overnight Oats have a runny consistency even after they soak, simply stir in an additional 1 tbsp chia seeds and place the mixture back in the fridge until it has thickened up. If the oat mixture is too thick, simply add a splash of milk and stir to combine.

ingredients.rawIngredient: Fresh mixed berries, or other fruit
ingredients.name: Fresh mixed berries, or other fruit

preparationSteps: In a small bowl, whisk together the oats, almond milk, chia seeds, banana, and cinnamon. Cover and refrigerate overnight to thicken.

In the morning, stir the oat mixture to combine. Serve the oats in a jar or parfait dish, alternating with layers of fresh fruit (such as mixed berries), granola, hemp seeds, and a drizzle of sweetener, if desired.

name: Ultimate Nutty Granola Clusters
note: Makes 6 cups

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 cup raw walnut halves or pieces
ingredients.name: raw walnut halves or pieces

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 cup raw buckwheat groats or gluten-free rolled oats
ingredients.name: raw buckwheat groats or gluten-free rolled oats

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2/3 cup mixed dried fruit (such as cranberries, apricots, cherries, etc)
ingredients.name: mixed dried fruit (such as cranberries, apricots, cherries, etc)

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 cup plus 2 tbsp pure maple syrup
ingredients.name: pure maple syrup

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 275℉. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place 1/2 cup of the almonds into a food processor and process for about 10 minutes, until a fine meal forms (similar in texture to sand). Transfer the almond meal to a large bowl.

In the food processor, combine the remaining 1/2 cup almonds and all of the walnuts and process for about 5 seconds, until finely chopped. You’ll be left with some larger pieces and some powdery meal, which is what you want. Add the mixture to the bowl with the almond meal.
Add the oats, buckwheat groats, dried fruit, pepita seeds, sunflower seeds, coconut, cinnamon, and salt to the large mixing bowl and stir to combine.
Add the maple syrup, melted oil, and vanilla to the bowl with the dry ingredients and stir until thoroughly combined.

With a spatula, spread the granola into a 1/2-inch layer on the prepared baking sheet and gently press down to compact it slightly. Bake for 20 minutes, then rotate the pan and bake for 18 to 25 minutes more, or until the granola is lightly golden on the bottom and firm to the touch.
Cool the granola on the pan for at least 1 hour before breaking it apart into clusters.
Store the granola in a glass jar in the fridge for 2 to 3 weeks or freeze it for 4 to 5 weeks.

name: Sunrise Scramble with Roasted Home Fries & Avocado Toast
note:
Leftover tofu scramble is great stuffed into a pita for a quick lunch. Add some salsa and avocado, and you are good to go!

For a grain-free optio, omit the avocado toast. For a fun way to change up home fries, try parsnips instead of potatoes.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 red bell pepper, seeded and finely chopped
ingredients.name: red bell pepper

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 cups destemmed kale leaves or baby spinach, finely chopped
ingredients.name: destemmed kale leaves or baby spinach

ingredients.rawIngredient: Flaxseed oil or extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.name: Flaxseed oil or extra-virgin olive oil

ingredients.rawIngredient: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Make the Roasted Home Fries: Preheat the oven to 425℉. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
Dice the russet and sweet potatoes into 1/2-inch or smaller pieces. The smaller you chop the potatoes, the faster they will cook.
In a large bowl, combine the diced potatoes, the arrowroot powder, and the salt and stir to combine. Stir in the coconut oil and mix until thoroughly combined.
Spread the potatoes into an even layer on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes, then flip the potatoes and bake for 15 to 25 minutes more, or until crispy, golden brown, and fork-tender.

Make the Tofu Scramble: In a large wok, combine the oil, garlic, shallots, and mushrooms and sauté over medium-high heat for 5 to 10 minutes, until most of the liquid released by the mushrooms has evaporated. Add the bell pepper, kale, nutritional yeast (if using), and smoked paprika. Stir well and continue cooking over medium-high heat.

Crumble or finely chop the tofu and add it to the work. Stir well to combine. Reduce the heat to medium and sauté for about 10 minutes more. Season with salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes, if desired.
Plate and serve the home fries, tofu scramble, and toast. Serve with a Flu-Fighter Sunshine Smoothie (pg 65), Morning Glory Smoothie (pg 66), or orange juice, if desired.

name: Maple-Cinnamon Apple & Pear Baked Oatmeal
note:
Enjoy this breakfast warmed or chilled; it’s lovely warmed on a chilly morning but it’s also nice straight from the fridge. 

To save time in the morning, prepare this oatmeal the night before. Cover the dish and refrigerate the unbaked oatmeal overnight. In the morning, simply preheat the oven and let the oatmeal sit on the counter while the oven gets hot. Uncover and stir the oatmeal mixture gently to redistribute the milk. Smooth out the top, if necessary, and bake as directed.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 tbsp coconut, Sucanat, or brown sugar
ingredients.name: coconut, Sucanat, or brown sugar

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 tsp freshly grated nutmeg, or 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg
ingredients.name: freshly grated nutmeg, or 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg

preparationSteps: Prehet the oven to 375℉. Lightly grease a 2-quart casserole dish.
In a large bowl, combine the rolled oats, sugar, cinnamon, baking powder, ginger, salt, and nutmeg. Mix well.
In a separate bowl, combine the almond milk, applesauce, maple syrup, and vanilla and stir well to combine.
Pour the liquid mixture over the oat mixture and stir until combined. The mixture will have a soupy consistency. Fold in the chopped apples and pear.
Spoon the oatmeal mixture into the prepared casserole dish and smooth out the top. Sprinkle the walnuts (if using) on top and gently press them down into the oatmeal with your hands.
Bake, uncovered, for 35 to 45 minutes, or until the oatmeal is bubbly around the corners and the apples are fork-tender.
Cool the oatmeal for 5 to 10 minutes before serving. Enjoy with a splash of almond milk and a drizzle of maple syrup, if desired.
Cool the oatmeal completely before wrapping it up and placing it in an airtight container. It will keep in the fridge for 5 to 6 days or in the freezer for 2 to 3 weeks.

name: Out-the-Door Chia Power Doughnuts
note: Makes 6 doughnuts
preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 300℉. Lightly grease a 6-cavity doughnut pan with oil. Set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the oat flour, chia seeds, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon.
Add the maple syrup, milk, and vanilla and stir until combined. The batter will be very runny, but this is normal.
Spoon the batter into the prepared doughnut pan, filling each cavity to the top.
Bake the doughnuts for 22 to 26 minutes, until firm to the touch. A toothpick inserted into a doughnut should come out clean.

Cool the doughnuts in the pan for about 10 minutes, and then carefully invert the pan onto a cooling rack. The doughnuts should pop right out — if they don’t, let them cool a bit more and gently run a butter knife along the edges of the wells to loosen them. Cool the doughnuts completely on the rack.
Drizzle Coconut-Lemon Whipped Cream over the top and enjoy. You can also use the whipped cream as a dip if you prefer a travel-friendly option.

name: Whipped Coconut Cream
note: Makes 3/4 to 1 cup

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 vanilla bean, seeds scraped, or 1/2 tsp pure vanilla extract
ingredients.name: vanilla bean, seeds scraped, or 1/2 tsp pure vanilla extract

preparationSteps: Chill the can of coconut milk in the fridge overnight (or for at least 9 to 10 hours).
About 1 hour before making the whipped cream, chill a bowl in the freezer.
Flip the chilled can upside down and open it with a can opener. Pour off the coconut water (you can reserve it for smoothies if you’d like).
Scoop the solid coconut cream into a chilled bowl.
Using an electric hand mixer, beat the cream until fluffy and smooth. add the sweetener (maple syrup) and the vanilla bean seeds and beat gently just to combine.

Cover the bowl and return the whipped cream to the fridge until ready to use. It will firm when chilled and soften at room temp. The whipped cream will keep in a sealed container in the fridge for 1 to 2 weeks.
For Coconut-Lemon Whipped Cream: Whip the coconut cream and add 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice and 2 tbsp sweetener of choice.
For Chocolate Fudge Whipped Cream: Whip the coconut cream and add 3 to 4 tbsp sifted cocoa powder, 2 tbsp sweetener of choice, 1/4 tsp pure vanilla extract, and a pinch of fine-grain sea salt.

name: Loaded Savory Oatmeal & Lentil Bowl

ingredients.rawIngredient: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: In a medium saucepan, combine the oats, lentils, broth, garlic (if using), and shallot (if using). Bring the mixture to a low boil over medium-high heat, then reduce the heat to a medium-low and simmer, uncovered, for 8 to 12 minutes, or until thickened. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Spoon the oatmeal into a bowl, add your desired toppings, and enjoy!

Store any leftovers in an airtight container. They will keep in the fridge for 2 to 3 days. To reheat, simply combine the oatmeal and a splash of vegetable broth in a small saucepan and heat over medium-low heat until warmed through.

name: Apple Pie Oatmeal

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 medium Gala apple, peeled, cored, and chopped into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.name: medium Gala apple, peeled, cored, and chopped into 1-inch pieces

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tsp ground cinnamon, plus more for serving
ingredients.name: ground cinnamon, plus more for serving

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tbsp pure maple syrup, to taste, plus more for serving
ingredients.name: pure maple syrup, to taste, plus more for serving

ingredients.rawIngredient: Pinch of unsweetened shredded coconut, for serving
ingredients.name: of unsweetened shredded coconut, for serving

preparationSteps: In a medium saucepan, over medium heat, combine the oats, apple, chia seeds, applesauce, almond milk, cinnamon, ginger, and salt. Whisk well to combine. Bring the mixture to a low boil over medium heat. Simmer for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring often.
When the mixture has thickened and the liquid has been absorbed, remove the pan from the heat and stir in the vanilla and maple syrup to taste.
Pour the oatmeal into a bowl and top it with chopped walnuts, hemp seeds, a pinch of cinnamon, a pinch of shredded coconut, and a drizzle of pure maple syrup.

name: Crunchy Seed & Oat Flatbread
note: This bread is fantastic toasted. Gently shake off any loose seeds before toasting to prevent them from falling into the toaster and burning. I love topping a toasted slice with sunflower seed butter and jam.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup unsweetened and unflavored non-dairy milk
ingredients.name: unsweetened and unflavored non-dairy milk

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tbsp coconut oil, melted, or olive oil
ingredients.name: coconut oil, melted, or olive oil

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 350℉. Lightly grease a 9-inch square pan and line it with two pieces of parchment paper, one going each way.
Make the Seed Topping: In a small bowl, combine the pepita, sunflower, chia, and sesame seeds to stir to combine. Set aside.
Make the Flatbread: In a high-speed blender, combine the oats, buckwheat and blend on high until a flour forms, 5 to 10 seconds.
In a large bowl, combine the oat and buckwheat flour, sunflower seeds, chia seed, sugar, oregano, thyme, baking powder, garlic powder, and salt. Whisk to combine.
Add the milk and oil to the bowl and stir very well until no clumps remain. Immediately pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth it out with a spatula.
Sprinkle the batter evenly with the prepared seed topping and the sea salt. Lightly press down on the topping with your hands to adhere it to the batter.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, uncovered, until the flatbread is firm to the touch.

Let the flatbread cool in the pan placed on a cooling rack for 15 minutes. Lift it out of the pan and place it on a clean work surface. Using a pizza cutter, slice it into 4 squares (or any number you wish).
Store the flatbread in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days. It can be frozen for up to 2 weeks.

name: Classic Green Monster
note:
It’s easy to make a double batch and refrigerate the leftovers in a jar for the next day. Or, prepare the smoothie at night and store it in the fridge for the next morning. Sometimes I do this if time is tight in the morning or if I have sleeping guests around. No one likes to be woken up by a Vitamix. 

Makes 1 (1 1/2 to 2 cup) smoothie. 

Add 1/2 cup frozen or fresh blueberries to this smoothie to give it a purple hue.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup almond milk or other non-dairy milk
ingredients.name: almond milk or other non-dairy milk

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup destemmed kale leves or baby spinach
ingredients.name: destemmed kale leves or baby spinach

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tbsp almond butter or peanut butter
ingredients.name: almond butter or peanut butter

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tbsp pure chia seeds or ground flaxseed
ingredients.name: pure chia seeds or ground flaxseed

preparationSteps: In a high-speed blender, combine all of the ingredients and blend until smooth.
Serve immediately and enjoy a burst of energy any time of the day!

name: Glowing Mojo-ito Green Monster
note:
Makes 1 (3-cup) smoothie.

If using water instead of coconut water, you might want to add a bit of liquid sweetener to make up for the lack of sweetness.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 to 1 1/2 cups baby spinach or other leafy green
ingredients.name: baby spinach or other leafy green

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 large sweet apple (such as Gala or Honeycrisp)
ingredients.name: large sweet apple (such as Gala or Honeycrisp)

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 to 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, to taste
ingredients.name: fresh lime juice

ingredients.rawIngredient: 5 to 10 large mint leaves, to taste
ingredients.name: large mint leaves

preparationSteps: Freeze the watermelon cubes (if using) overnight or until frozen solid.
In a high-speed blender, combine all of the ingredients and blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and toast to green drinks.

name: Cheerful Chocolate Smoothie
note:
Instead of regular ice cubes, try using coffee ice cubes for this smoothie. They add an incredible mocha flavor. 

If you have leftover avocado, you can freeze it for 1 to 2 weeks and use it  for future smoothies. 

If your dates are firm, be sure to soak them in a bowl of water to soften before use.

ingredients.rawIngredient: Very small pinch of fine-grain sea salt
ingredients.name: Very small pinch of fine-grain sea salt

ingredients.rawIngredient: 4 to 6 pitted medium Medjool dates, to taste
ingredients.name: pitted medium Medjool dates

preparationSteps: In a high-speed blender, combine the almond milk, avocado, cocoa powder, and vanilla and blend on high speed until smooth.
Add the salt, pitted dates, ice, and espresso powder (if using). Blend again until smooth.

name: Velvety Pumpkin Pie Smoothie
note:
Makes 1 (2-cup) smoothie.

If your blender has a difficult time blending rolled oats, place the oats and milk in the blender, stir, and let sit for 10 to 15 minutes to soften. Then proceed with smoothie making.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 to 1 tsp blackstrap molasses, to taste
ingredients.name: blackstrap molasses

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tsp ground cinnamon, plus more for serving
ingredients.name: ground cinnamon, plus more for serving

ingredients.rawIngredient: Whippped Coconut Cream (see pg 280), for serving
ingredients.name: Whippped Coconut Cream (see pg 280), for serving

preparationSteps: In a high-speed blender, combine the milk, oats, pumpkin, molasses, banana, cinnamon, ginger, and nutmeg. Blend on high speed until smooth. Add the ice cubes and blend until ice cold.
Add the maple syrup and blend briefly to combine.
Serve with the Whipped Coconut Cream and a sprinkle of cinnamon, if desired.

name: Gym Rat Smoothie
note:
Makes 1 (1 3/4 cup) smoothie.

If your blender has a difficult time pureeing rolled oats and dates, place the oats, pitted dates, and almond milk in the blender, stir, and let sit for 10 to 15 minutes to soften. Then proceed with your smoothie making.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 to 3 pitted Medjool dates, to taste
ingredients.name: pitted Medjool dates

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tbsp peanut butter or almond butter
ingredients.name: peanut butter or almond butter

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 to 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, to taste
ingredients.name: ground cinnamon

preparationSteps: In a high-speed blender, combine all of the ingredients and blend until smooth.

name: Flu-Fighter Sunshine Smoothie
note:
Makes 1 (1 3/4 cup) smoothie.

If you’d like this smoothie served warm, omit the ice and keep blending on high speed for a few minutes, until the heat of the blender motor warms the mixture.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, or to taste
ingredients.name: fresh lemon juice, or to taste

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tsp grated peeled fresh ginger, or to taste
ingredients.name: grated peeled fresh ginger, or to taste

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 to 3 tsp pure maple syrup, to taste
ingredients.name: pure maple syrup

preparationSteps: In a high-speed blender, combine all of the ingredients and blend until smooth. Drink and get ready to feel better in a flash.

name: Morning Glory Smoothie
note: Makes 1 (2-cup) smoothie.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup fresh or frozen strawberries, hulled
ingredients.name: fresh or frozen strawberries, hulled

preparationSteps: In a high-speed blender, combine all of the ingredients and blend until smooth.

name: Tropical Beauty Green Monster
note: Makes 1 (2-cup) smoothie.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup destemmed kale leaves or baby spinach
ingredients.name: destemmed kale leaves or baby spinach

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup frozen mango, or 1 fresh mango, chopped
ingredients.name: frozen mango, or 1 fresh mango
