ingredients.name: fresh or frozen pineapple chunks

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 to 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, to taste
ingredients.name: fresh lime juice

preparationSteps: In a high-speed blender, combine all of the ingredients and blend until smooth.

name: Summertime Cherry-Basil Bruschetta

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup fresh cherries, pitted and finely chopped
ingredients.name: fresh cherries, pitted and finely chopped

ingredients.rawIngredient: 3 cups fresh strawberries, hulled and finely chopped
ingredients.name: fresh strawberries, hulled and finely chopped

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 cup packed fresh basil leaves, minced
ingredients.name: packed fresh basil leaves

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 fresh baguette, sliced on an angle into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.name: fresh baguette, sliced on an angle into 1-inch pieces

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 450℉.
In a large bowl, combine the cherries, strawberries, basil, mint, onion, and vinegar. Set the bruschetta topping aside for 10 to 15 minutes so the flavors can develop.
Brush one side of each piece of bread with oil and place them oil side down on a large rimmed baking sheet. Bake for 5 to 7 minutes, watching closely, until golden.
Spoon the bruschetta topping carefully onto the toasted bread. Drizzle each piece with some of the Balsamic Reduction and serve immediately.

name: Balsamic Reduction
preparationSteps: In a medium saucepan, bring the vinegar to a low boil over medium-high heat. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer the vinegar, stirring often, for 20 to 30 minutes, until it has reduced by two-thirds. Keep an eye on the vinegar to avoid burning it and reduce the heat if necessary. You should have about 1/3 cup of reduced balsamic vinegar left in the pan.

Remove the pan from the heat and let cool. Transfer the reduction to an airtight container and refrigerate for up to 1 month. The reduction will thicken and firm up once chilled. Allow it to come to room temperature before using.

name: Glowing Strawberry-Mango Guacamole
note:
Makes 3 cups. 

For a spicy version, add 1 diced jalapeño to the mix.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 medium avocados, pitted and roughly chopped
ingredients.name: medium avocados, pitted and roughly chopped

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 fresh mango, pitted, peeled, and finely chopped (about 1 1/2 cups)
ingredients.name: fresh mango, pitted, peeled, and finely chopped (about 1 1/2 cups)

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, roughly chopped
ingredients.name: fresh cilantro leaves

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 to 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, to taste
ingredients.name: fresh lime juice

preparationSteps: In a medium bowl, gently mash the avocado, leaving some chunks for texture.

Rinse and drain the chopped onion in a strainer to wash off the sulfurous compounds. This makes the taste of the raw onion more pleasant. Fold the mango, strawberries, onion, and cilantro (if using) into the avocado. Season with the lime juice and salt to taste.
Serve immediately with your favorite corn chips (or try my Spiced Toasted Pita Chips, page 91). Avocado tends to spoil quickly, so leftovers won’t keep for longer than 12 hours or so.

name: Life-Affirming Warm Nacho Dip

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 to 3 handfuls of baby spinach (about 3 ounces), roughly chopped
ingredients.name: handfuls of baby spinach (about 3 ounces)

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/3 cup crushed corn chips or bread crumbs
ingredients.name: crushed corn chips or bread crumbs

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 to 2 green onions, finely sliced, for serving (optional)
ingredients.name: green onions, finely sliced, for serving (optional)

ingredients.rawIngredient: Tortilla chips or Spiced Toasted Pita Chips (pg 91), for serving
ingredients.name: Tortilla chips or Spiced Toasted Pita Chips (pg 91), for serving

preparationSteps: Make the Cheese Sauce: Place the cashews in a medium bowl and add water to cover. Set aside to soak for at least 2 hours, or overnight if you have the time. Drain and rinse the soaked cashews.
Preheat the oven to 400℉. Lightly grease a 2-quart cast-iron pan or casserole dish.

Place the carrots in a small saucepan and add water to cover. Bring the water to a boil and cook the carrots for 5 minutes, or until just fork-tender. Drain. You can also steam the carrots, if desired.

In a blender, combine the soaked and drained cashews, cooked carrots, nutritional yeast, lemon juice, garlic, salt, chili powder, onion powder, cayenne (if using) and 2/3 cup water and blend until silky smooth, adding a splash of extra water if needed. Pour the sauce into a large bowl.

Make the Dip: Stir the marinara sauce, onion, and spinach into the Cheese Sauce until fully combined. Spoon the sauce into the prepared dish and smooth out, and sprinkle the top evenly with the crushed corn chips.

Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, uncovered, watching closely toward the end of the cooking time to make sure the corn chip topping doesn’t burn. Garnish with sliced green onion, if desired. Serve immediately with tortilla chips or Spiced Toasted Pita Chips.
Reheat any leftovers in the oven at 400℉ for 10 to 20 minutes, or until heated through. Store the dip in an airtight container in the fridge for 3 to 5 days.

name: Taco Fiesta Potato Crips
note: Makes 28 to 30 crisps.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 russet potatoes, unpeeled, sliced into 1/4-inch rounds
ingredients.name: russet potatoes, unpeeled, sliced into 1/4-inch rounds

ingredients.rawIngredient: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Make the Potato Crisps: Preheat the oven to 425℉. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Place the potato slices in a single layer on the baking sheet and drizzle them with the oil. Rub the potatoes to disperse the oil evenly. Sprinkle the potatoes generously with salt and pepper.
Roast the potatoes for 30 to 35 minutes, flipping them once halfway through, until tender and lightly browned. Allow the potatoes to cool for 5 minutes before assembling.

Make the Walnut Taco Meat: In a mini food processor, combine the walnuts, oil, chili powder, cumin, salt, and cayenne and process into a fine crumble. (You can also chop and mix the ingredients by hand, if preferred). Set aside.

To assemble, top each potato slice with 1 tsp of the Cashew Sour Cream, followed by about 1 tsp each of the walnut taco meat, salsa, and green onions, in that order. Garnish with pepper. Serve immediately, while still warm.

name: Spiced Toasted Pita Chips
preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 400℉.
With the kitchen shears, cut the pitas into wedges about the size of tortilla chips. Arrange them in a single layer on a large rimmed baking sheet.
With the pastry brush, spread the oil on the pita wedges and sprinkle them generously with the garlic powder, cumin, paprika, and salt.
Bake for 7 to 9 minute, or until golden. Remove from the oven and let cool. The chips will firm up after about 5 to 10 mintues of cooling.

name: Oil-Free Baked Falafel Bites
note: Makes 22 bite-size falafel

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 cup plus 6 tbsp  spelt bread crumbs or Sprouted-Grain Bread Crumbs (see pg 279)
ingredients.name: spelt bread crumbs or Sprouted-Grain Bread Crumbs (see pg 279)

ingredients.rawIngredient: Leaves from 1 head of Bibb, Boston, or romaine lettuce
ingredients.name: from 1 head of Bibb, Boston, or romaine lettuce

preparationSteps: Make the Falafel: Preheat the oven to 400℉. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.

In a food processor, pulse the garlic to finely chop it. Add the onion, cilantro, and parsley and process until minced. Add the chickpeas and process until the mixture forms a coarse dough and holds together when pressed between your fingers.
Transfer the mixture to a large bowl and stir in the flaxseed, 1/4 cup of the bread crumbs, cumin, and salt until combined.
Shape the mixture into small patties, using about 1 tbsp dough for each and pressing each firmly to hold its shape. Repeat until you have used all of the chickpea mixture.

With a pastry brush, brush a few drops of water onto each patty. One at a time, roll the patties in the remaining 6 tbsp bread crumbs, pressing down on each side so the bread crumbs stick. (The crumbs don’t tend to stick that well, so you have to make an effort to press them into the patty.)
Repeat until all of the patties have been coated. Place the patties onto prepared baking sheet.
Bake the falafel until golden brown, about 30 minutes, flipping once halfway through the baking time.
Make the Tomato-Cucumber Salsa: In a food processor, combine the tomatoes, onion, cilantro, and lime juice and process until roughly chopped. Stir in the diced cucumber and salt to taste.

To assemble, arrange the lettuce leaves in a single layer on a serving tray. Place 1 falafel in the center of each lettuce leaf. Top with some of the Tomato-Cucumber Salsa and drizzle of Lemon-Tahini Dressing.

name: Lemon-Tahini Dressing
note: Makes 2/3 cup. The dressing will thicken up a bit once chilled. Feel free to thin it out, if necessary, with a tbsp or two of water or oil.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 to 2 tbsp sesame oil or extra-virgin olive oil, to taste
ingredients.name: sesame oil or extra-virgin olive oil

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 tsp fine-grain sea salt, or to taste
ingredients.name: fine-grain sea salt, or to taste

preparationSteps: In a food processor, pulse the garlic to mince it. Add the tahini, lemon juice, nutritional yeast, oil, water, and salt and process until smooth.

name: Perfected Chickpea Salad Sandwich

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 cup finely chopped red bell pepper
ingredients.name: finely chopped red bell pepper

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 to 3 tbsp store-bought or homemade vegan mayo (see pg 278)
ingredients.name: store-bought or homemade vegan mayo (see pg 278)

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 1/2 to 3 tsp fresh lemon juice, to taste
ingredients.name: fresh lemon juice

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 tsp fine-grain sea salt, or to taste
ingredients.name: fine-grain sea salt, or to taste

ingredients.rawIngredient: Toasted bread, crackers, tortillas, or lettuce, for serving
ingredients.name: Toasted bread, crackers, tortillas, or lettuce, for serving

preparationSteps: In a large bowl, mash the chickpeas with a potato masher until flaky in texture.
Stir in the celery, green onions, pickles, bell peppers, mayo, and garlic until combined.
Stir in the mustard and dill (if using) and season with the lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, adjusting the quantities to taste.
Serve with toasted bread, on crackers, in a tortilla or lettuce wrap, or on top of a basic leafy green salad.

name: Creamy Avocado-Potato Salad

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 1/2 to 2 lbs yellow potatoes, chopped into 1/2-inch cubes
ingredients.name: yellow potatoes, chopped into 1/2-inch cubes

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 bunch asparagus, woody ends broken off, stalks chopped into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.name: asparagus, woody ends broken off, stalks chopped into 1-inch pieces

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 tsp fine-grain sea salt, or to taste, plus more for serving
ingredients.name: fine-grain sea salt, or to taste, plus more for serving

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 425℉. Line two rimmed baking sheets with parchment paper.

Spread the potatoes in an even layer on one of the prepared baking sheets and drizzle them with 1 1/2 tsp of the oil. Season with half of the salt and pepper. Spread the asparagus on the second baking sheet and drizzle with the remaining 1 1/2 tsp oil. Season with the remaining salt and pepper.

Roast the potatoes for 15 minutes, flip them, and roast for 15 to 20 mins more, until golden and fork-tender. During the last 15 minutes of roasting the potatoes, place the asparagus in the oven for roast for 9 to 12 minutes, until tender. Transfer the roasted potatoes and asparagus to a large bowl and stir in the green onions.
Make the dressing: In a mini food processor, combine the avocado, dill, lemon juice, green onion, salt, pepper, to taste, and 1/4 cup water and process until smooth.

Add the dressing to the bowl with the potatoes and asparagus and stir until combined. Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve immediately. The salad is also good chilled and will keep in an airtight container in the fridge for a couple of days.

name: Chakra Caesar Salad with Nutty Herb Croutons
preparationSteps: Make the dressing: Place the almonds in a bowl and add enough water to cover. Soak the almonds for at least 12 hours, or overnight. Drain and rinse the almonds. Pop off the skins by pressing the base of each almond between your thumb and fore-finger. (Removing the skins yields a smoother dressing, but it’s not absolutely essential.)
Preheat the oven to 425℉.

Cut off the top of the garlic head so all of the raw cloves are exposed. Remove any loose skin. Wrap the head in foil and place it on a baking sheet. Roast the garlic for 35 to 40 minutes, or until the cloves are soft and golden. Let cool for 10 to 15 minutes, until cool enough to handle. Remove the foil and squeeze the garlic cloves out of their skins and into a food processor.

Add the soaked almonds, oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, salt, dry mustard, pepper, and 1/4 cup water to the food processor and process until smooth, stopping to scrape down the bowl as needed. Taste and add more salt and pepper as needed. Add the minced raw garlic if you’d like the dressing to have a more intense garlic flavor - otherwsie, leave it out.
Place the lettuce in a large salad bowl and pour your desired amount of dressing on top. Toss until fully coated. Sprinkle the Nutty Herb Croutons over the salad just before serving.

name: Nutty Herb Croutons

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 tbsp packed fresh parsley,  or 1 tsp dried parsley
ingredients.name: packed fresh parsley,  or 1 tsp dried parsley

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 tbsp packed fresh basil, or 1 tsp dried basil
ingredients.name: packed fresh basil, or 1 tsp dried basil

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tbsp fresh thyme, or 1/2 tsp dried thyme
ingredients.name: fresh thyme, or 1/2 tsp dried thyme

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tbsp fresh rosemary, or 1/2 tsp dried rosemary
ingredients.name: fresh rosemary, or 1/2 tsp dried rosemary

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 300℉. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a small bowl, combine the flaxseed, oil, and 2 tbsp water and stir. Set aside for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mixture has thickened.

In a food processor, pulse the garlic to mince it. Add the almonds and process until finely chopped. Add the onion, parsley, basil, thyme, rosemary, oregano, salt, and flaxseed mixture and process until a sticky ball of dough forms.

With your fingers, sprinkle small portions of the crouton dough onto the prepared baking sheet, using roughly 1/2 tsp of dough per crouton. Place the croutons 1 inch apart on the baking sheet and sprinkle with Herbamare.
Bake for 20 minutes, then gently flip the croutons and bake for 10 to 15 minutes more, until golden. Watch the croutons closely near the end of the baking time to make sure they don’t burn.
Let the croutons cool on the pan for 10 minutes. They will firm up while cooling. Cool the croutons completely and store in an airtight glass jar for 2 to 4 weeks.

name: Long Weekend Grilled Salad
note: If you’d like to boost the protein content of this salad, feel free to add 1 (15-ounce) can of black beans, drained and rinsed.

ingredients.rawIngredient: Coconut oil or grapeseed oil, for brushing
ingredients.name: Coconut oil or grapeseed oil, for brushing

ingredients.rawIngredient: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.rawIngredient: 3 bell peppers (1 red, 1 yellow, 1 orange), quartered lengthwise
ingredients.name: bell peppers (1 red, 1 yellow, 1 orange), quartered lengthwise

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tsp agave nectar or other liquid sweetener
ingredients.name: agave nectar or other liquid sweetener

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 tsp fine-grain sea salt, plus more as needed
ingredients.name: fine-grain sea salt, plus more as needed

ingredients.rawIngredient: Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
ingredients.name: Freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.rawIngredient: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

preparationSteps: Make the grilled vegetables: Brush each ear of corn with some coconut oil and season with salt and black pepper. Wrap each ear with foil, twisting the ends to secure.
Brush coconut oil on each piece of bell pepper and zucchini and season with salt and black pepper.

Preheat a grill to medium for about 10 minutes. Place the corn, bell peppers, and zucchini on the grill, on the top rack, if possible. Grill for 10 to 15 minutes, rotating every 5 minutes. When the peppers and zucchini are lightly charred and tender, remove them from the grill and set aside on a platter. Continue grilling the corn for 10 to 15 minutes more, 20 to 25 minutes total. Set aside until cool enough to handle.
Make the dressing: In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lime juice, garlic, cilantro, agave, salt, and black pepper to taste.
To assemble the salad, stand each ear of corn in a shallow dish and using a chef’s knife, remove the corn kernels from the cob by slicing downward along the length of the corn.

Chop the grilled bell peppers and zucchini and place them in a large bowl. Slice and add the avocado. Add the corn kernelss and the dressing and toss to combine. Season generously with salt and black pepper. (I usually end up adding another handlful of chopped cilantro, too, but that’s optional.)

name: Delicata Squash, Millet & Kale Salad with Lemon-Tahini Dressing
note: Try roasting the red onion along with the squash for a deep, caramlized flavor.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 delicata squash, halved lengthwise and seeded
ingredients.name: delicata squash, halved lengthwise and seeded

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tbsp grapeseed or melted coconut oil
ingredients.name: grapeseed or melted coconut oil

ingredients.rawIngredient: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 to 1 bunch kale, stems removed, leaves torn into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.name: kale, stems removed, leaves torn into 1-inch pieces

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 tbsp raw or toasted pepita seeds
ingredients.name: raw or toasted pepita seeds

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 425℉. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.

Slice the squash crosswise into 1-inch-wide pieces (they should be the shape of a U) and place them in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Drizzle them with the oil and toss to combine. Season generously with salt and pepper.
Roast the squash for about 30 minutes, flipping once halfway through the cooking time. The squash is ready when golden and fork-tender.
Meanwhile, cook the millet according to the instructions on page 302.

Place the kale in a large bowl and spoon 2 to 4 tbsp of the Lemon-Tahini Dressing over the top. Massage the dressing into the kale with your hands until all the leaves are coated. Let the kale sit on the counter for at least 10 to 15 minutes (or longer, if desired) so the dressing can soften the kale leaves.

To assemble the salad, place the dressing-coated kale on a large serving plate. Spread the cooked millet over the top, followed by the onion, celery, parsley, roasted squash, cranberries, and pepita seeds. Drizzle with the rest of the dressing.

name: On the Mend Spiced Red Lentil-Kale Soup

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tsp coconut oil or olive oil
ingredients.name: coconut oil or olive oil

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 to 1/2 tsp smoked paprika, to taste
ingredients.name: smoked paprika

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/8 tsp cayenne pepper, or to taste
ingredients.name: cayenne pepper, or to taste

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 (14-ounce) can diced tomatoes, with their juices
ingredients.name: diced tomatoes, with their juices

ingredients.rawIngredient: 5 to 6 cups vegetable broth, plus more as needed
ingredients.name: vegetable broth, plus more as needed

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup uncooked red lentils, rinsed and drained
ingredients.name: uncooked red lentils

ingredients.rawIngredient: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 handfuls destemmed torn kale leaves or spinach
ingredients.name: handfuls destemmed torn kale leaves or spinach

preparationSteps: In a large saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and sauté for 5 to 6 minutes, until the onion is translucent. Add the celery, season with salt, and sauté for a few more minutes.
Add the bay leaf, cumin, chili powder, coriander, paprika, and cayenne and stir to combine. Sauté for a couple of minutes, until fragrant.

Stir in the tomatoes with their juices, the broth, and the lentils. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium and simmer, uncovered, for 20 to 25 minutes, until the lentils are tender and fluffy. Season with salt and pepper. Remove and discard the bay leaf.
Stir in the kale and cook for a few minutes more, until it has wilted. Serve immediately.

name: Summer Harvest Tortilla Soup
note: To make toasted tortilla strips, follow the recipe for Spiced Toasted Pita Chips on pg 91, but use tortillas instead of pita bread and slice the tortillas into thin 2-inch strips before toasting. For a heartier soup, try adding brown or wild rice.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 jalapeño, seeded, if desired, and diced (optional)
ingredients.name: jalapeño, seeded, if desired, and diced (optional)

ingredients.rawIngredient: Kernels from 2 ears fresh corn, or 1 1/2 cups frozen corn kernels
ingredients.name: Kernels from 2 ears fresh corn, or 1 1/2 cups frozen corn kernels

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 (15-ounce) can black beans, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: black beans

preparationSteps: In a large saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and sauté for about 5 minutes. Season with salt and black pepper.
Stir in the bell pepper, jalapeño (if using), corn kernels, and zucchini. Raise the heat to medium-high and sauté for 10 minutes more.
Add the crushed tomatoes, broth, cumin, chili powder, and cayenne and stir well. Season with salt and black pepper.
Bring the soup to a low boil and reduce the heat to medium. Simmer, uncovered, for 10 to 15 minutes, until the vegetables are tender. Stir in the black beans and simmer for 2 minutes more.
Ladle the soup into bowls and garnish with your choice of toppings.

name: 10-Spice Vegetable Soup with Cashew Cream
note: If you don’t have the ingredients on hand to make the 10-Spice Blend, feel free to use your favorite store-bought Cajun or Creole seasoning mix and add to taste.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 3/4 cup raw cashews, soaked at least 3-4 hours
ingredients.name: raw cashews, soaked at least 3-4 hours

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 1/2 cups peeled and chopped sweet potato, regular potato, or butternut squash
ingredients.name: peeled and chopped sweet potato, regular potato, or butternut squash

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 (28-ounce) can diced tomatoes, with their juices
ingredients.name: diced tomatoes, with their juices

ingredients.rawIngredient: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
ingredients.name: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 to 2 cups baby spinach or destemmed kale leaves (optional)
ingredients.name: baby spinach or destemmed kale leaves (optional)

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 (15-ounce) can chickpeas or other beans, drained and rinsed (optional)
ingredients.name: chickpeas or other beans

preparationSteps: In a blender, combine the soaked and drained cashews with 1 cup of the vegetable broth and blend on the highest speed until smooth. Set aside.
In a large saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the garlic and onion and sauté for 3 to 5 minutes, or until the onion is translucent.

Add the carrots, bell pepper, potato, celery, diced tomatoes with their juices, remaining 5 cups broth, the cashew cream, and the 10-Spice Blend. Stir well to combine. Bring the mixture to a boil and then reduce the heat to medium-low. Season with salt and black pepper and add the bay leaves.

Simmer the soup, uncovered, for at least 20 minutes, until the vegetables are tender. Season with salt and black pepper. During the last 5 minutes of cooking, stir in the spinach and beans, if desired. Remove and discard the bay leaves before serving.

name: 10-Spice Blend
preparationSteps: Combine all of the ingredients in a medium jar. Secure the lid and shake to combine. Shake the jar before each use.

name: Eat Your Greens Detox Soup

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 1/2 tsp coconut oil or olive oil
ingredients.name: coconut oil or olive oil

ingredients.rawIngredient: 3 cups sliced cremini or white button mushrooms (about 8 ounces)
ingredients.name: sliced cremini or white button mushrooms (about 8 ounces)

ingredients.rawIngredient: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
ingredients.name: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 1/2 to 3 tsp grated peeled fresh ginger
ingredients.name: grated peeled fresh ginger

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 large nori seaweed sheets, cut into 1-inch strips (optional)
ingredients.name: large nori seaweed sheets

preparationSteps: In a large saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and sauté for about 5 minutes, until the onion is soft and translucent.
Add the mushrooms, carrots, broccoli, and stir to combine. Season generously with salt and pepper and sauté for 5 minutes more.
Stir in the ginger, turmeric, cumin, and cinnamon and sauté for 1 to 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the broth and stir to combine. Bring the mixture to a boil and then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer until vegetables are tender, 10 to 20 minutes.
Just before serving, stir in the nori (if using) and kale and cook until wilted. Season with salt and pepper and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice, if desired.

name: Empowered Noodle Bowl

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 recipe Thai Peanut Sauce or Orange-Maple Miso Dressing
ingredients.name: recipe Thai Peanut Sauce or Orange-Maple Miso Dressing

ingredients.rawIngredient: Extra-virgin olive oil, for the noodles
ingredients.name: Extra-virgin olive oil, for the noodles

ingredients.rawIngredient: 4 green onions, chopped, plus more for serving
ingredients.name: green onions, chopped, plus more for serving

preparationSteps: Cook the soba noodles according to the instructions on the package. Be sure not to overcook them − they should only take 5 to 9 minutes, depending on the brand. Drain the noodles and rinse them under cold water. Transfer the noodles to a large bowl and toss them with a drizzle of extra-virgin olive oil (this prevents the noodles from sticking together).
Add the edamame, bell pepper, cucumber, carrot, green onions, and cilantro to the bowl with the noodles and toss until well combined.
Pour the desired amont of the dressing over the salad and toss to coat. (Any leftover dressing will keep in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 1 week.)
Portion the salad into 4 bowls and garnish each serving with a sprinkle of sesame seeds and some green onions. Serve any leftover dressing on the side.

name: Thai Peanut Sauce

ingredients.rawIngredient: 3 tbsp fresh lime juice, plus more as needed
ingredients.name: fresh lime juice, plus more as needed

preparationSteps: In a mini food processor, combine the garlic, sesame oil, peanut butter, ginger (if using), lime juice, tamarind, sugar (if using), and 2 to 3 tbsp water. Process until combined.

name: Orange-Maple Miso Dressing
preparationSteps: In a mini food processor, combine the miso, vinegar, sesame oil, tahini, orange juice, water, and maple syrup and process until well combined.

name: Broccoli & Cashew Cheese-Quinoa Burrito

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tsp white wine vinegar or lemon juice
ingredients.name: white wine vinegar or lemon juice

ingredients.rawIngredient: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.name: Fine-grain sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.rawIngredient: 3 to 4 tbsp chopped, oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, to taste
ingredients.name: chopped, oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes

preparationSteps: Make the Cashew Cheese Sauce: Place the cashews in a bowl and add enough water to cover. Soak the cashes for at least 3 to 4 hours, preferably longer if you have time. Drain and rinse the cashews.
In a food processor or blender, combine the soaked cashews, garlic, almond milk, nutritional yeast, mustard, vinegar, onion powder, and salt and process until smooth. The sauce should be very thick.
Make the burrito: Cook the quinoa according to the instructions on page 302. Set aside.
In a large wok, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the garlic and onion and sauté for about 5 minutes, until the onion is translucent. Season with salt and pepper.
Stir in the celery, broccoli, and sun-dried tomatoes, to taste. Sauté over medium-high heat until the broccoli is tender, 10 to 15 minutes.

Add the cooked quinoa and cheese sauce and stir to combine with the vegetables. Add red pepper flakes, if desired. Cook until heated through, 5 to 10 minutes. Spoon the mixture onto the tortillas, wrap, and serve. You can also grill or press the burrito before serving, if desired.

name: Quick & Easy Chana Masala
note: To thicken the tomato gravy, place a ladle of the curry in a mini processor and process until almost smooth. Stir this back into the curry to thicken.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tbsp coconut oil or olive oil
ingredients.name: coconut oil or olive oil

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 green serrano pepper, seeded and minced
ingredients.name: green serrano pepper

ingredients.rawIngredient: 3/4 tsp fine-grain sea salt, plus more as needed
ingredients.name: fine-grain sea salt, plus more as needed

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 (28-ounce) can whole peeled or diced tomatoes, with their juices
ingredients.name: whole peeled or diced tomatoes, with their juices

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 (28-ounce) can chickpeas, or 3 cups cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: chickpeas, or 3 cups cooked chickpeas

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup dry/uncooked basmati rice, for serving (see page 302 for cooking instructions)
ingredients.name: dry/uncooked basmati rice, for serving (see page 302 for cooking instructions)

preparationSteps: In a large wok or saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat. When a drop of water sizzles upon hitting the pan, reduce the heat to medium-low and add the cumin seeds. Stir and toast the seeds for a minute or two until golden and fragrant, watching carefully to avoid burning.

Raise the heat to medium and stir in the onion, garlic, ginger, and serrano. Cook for a few minutes or so, then stir in the garam masala, coriander, turmeric, salt, and cayenne (if using), and cook for 2 minutes more.
Add the whole peeled tomatoes and their juices and break them apart with a wooden spoon (skip if using diced tomatoes). You can leave some chunks of tomato for texture.
Raise the heat to medium-high and add the chickpeas. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes or longer to allow the flavors to develop.
Serve over cooked basmati ice, if desired, and garnish with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice and some chopped cilantro just before serving.

name: 15-Minute Creamy Avocado Pasta
note: Because avocados oxidize quickly after you slice them, this sauce is best served immediately. If you have leftover sauce, transfer it to an airtight container and refrigerate for up to 1 day.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 cup fresh basil leaves, plus more for serving
ingredients.name: fresh basil leaves, plus more for serving

ingredients.rawIngredient: 4 to 6 tsp fresh lemon juice, to taste
ingredients.name: fresh lemon juice

preparationSteps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta according to the instructions on the package.
While the pasta cooks, make the sauce: In a food processor, combine the garlic and basil and pulse to mince.

Add the lemon juice, oil, avocado flesh, and 1 tbsp water and process until smooth, stopping to scrape down the bowl as needed. If the sauce is too thick, add another 1 tbsp water. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Drain the pasta and place it back in the pot. Add the avocado sauce and stir until combined. You can gently rewarm the pasta if it has cooled slightly, or simply serve it at room temp.
Top with lemon zest, pepper, and fresh basil leaves, if desired.

name: Protein Power Goddess Bowl

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice (from about 2 lemons)
ingredients.name: fresh lemon juice (from about 2 lemons)

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 to 3 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil, to taste
ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 tsp fine-grain sea salt, or to taste
ingredients.name: fine-grain sea salt, or to taste

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup uncooked green lentils or a mixture of green and black lentils
ingredients.name: uncooked green lentils or a mixture of green and black lentils

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup uncooked spelt berries or wheat berries, soaked overnight
ingredients.name: uncooked spelt berries or wheat berries, soaked overnight

ingredients.rawIngredient: 3 cups spinach or lacinato kale, roughly chopped
ingredients.name: spinach or lacinato kale

preparationSteps: Make the Lemon-Tahini Goddess Dressing: In a food processor, combine the tahini, garlic, lemon juice, nutritional yeast, extra-virgin olive oil,  1/2 tsp salt, and black pepper to taste and process until smooth. Set aside until ready to use.
Cook the lentils according to the instructions on page 302. Set aside.
Cook the spelt berries according to the instructions on page 302. Set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and sauté for a few minutes, until the onion is translucent.
Add the bell pepper and tomato and sauté for 7 to 8 minutes more, until most of the liquid has cooked off.
Stir in the spinach and sauté for a few more minutes more, until the greens wilt.

Stir in all of the Lemon-Tahini Goddess Dressing and the cooked lentils and spelt berries. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for a few minutes more. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the minced parsley.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

name: Luxurious Tomato-Basil Pasta

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 cup raw cashews, soaked for at least 2 hours
ingredients.name: raw cashews, soaked for at least 2 hours

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 1/2 cups diced fresh or canned tomatoes (drain juice, if using canned)
ingredients.name: diced fresh or canned tomatoes (drain juice, if using canned)

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 to 3 tbsp nutritional yeast, to taste
ingredients.name: nutritional yeast

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup packed fresh basil, finely chopped
ingredients.name: packed fresh basil

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 to 3 tbsp tomato paste, to taste
ingredients.name: tomato paste

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 tsp fine-grain sea salt, or to taste
ingredients.name: fine-grain sea salt, or to taste

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 tsp freshly ground black pepper, or to taste
ingredients.name: freshly ground black pepper, or to taste

preparationSteps: Place the cashews in a bowl and add enough water to cover. Soak the cashews for at least 2 hours, or overnight. Drain and rinse the cashews. Place them in a blender along with the almond milk and blend on the highest speed until smooth. Set aside.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Prepare the pasta according to the instructions on the package, cooking until al dente.

In a large wok, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and sauté for 5 to 10 minutes, or until the onion is translucent. Add the diced tomatoes and spinach and continue cooking for 7 to 10 minutes over medium-high heat, until the spinach is wilted.
Stir in the cashew cream, nutritional yeast (if using), basil, tomato paste, oregano, salt, and pepper, and cook for 5 to 10 minutes more, or until heated through.
Drain the pasta and add it to the wok. Stir to combine the pasta with the sauce. Cook for a few minutes, or until heated through. Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve immediately.

name: Pan-Seared Garlic Tofu

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 tbsp melted coconut oil, or grapeseed oil
ingredients.name: melted coconut oil, or grapeseed oil

preparationSteps: Following the instructions on page 285, press the tofu overnight, or for at least 25 to 30 minutes.
Slice the pressed tofu into 9 to 10 1/2-inch rectangles and then slice each rectangle into 6 squares, to make a total of 54 to 60 tofu pieces.
Preheat a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat for several minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the tofu squares, garlic powder, salt, and pepper and toss until fully coated.

When a drop of water sizzles on the skillet, it’s ready. Add the oil and tilt the skillet to coat it evenly with the oil. Carefully add the tofu to the pan (be careful, as the oil might splatter; use a splatter guard if needed) in a single layer, making sure all the pieces lay flat against the skillet.
Cook the tofu for 3 to 5 minutes, until a golden crust forms. Flip each piece and cook for 3 to 5 minutes more, until golden. Serve immediately.

name: Perfect Kale Chips

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 bunch kale, stems removed and leaves torn
ingredients.name: kale, stems removed and leaves torn

ingredients.rawIngredient: Ketchup, sriracha, or salad dressing, for dipping
ingredients.name: Ketchup, sriracha, or salad dressing, for dipping

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 300℉. Line two large rimmed baking sheets with parchment paper. Wash the kale leaves and dry them completely in a salad spinner.
Place the kale leaves in a large bowl and drizzle with the oil. Massage the oil into the kale with your hands until the leaves are thoroughly coated with the oil.

Place the kale in a single layer on the prepared baking sheets. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, and other spices or seasonings, if desired. Bake for 10 minutes, then rotate the pans and bake for 7 to 10 minutes more, until the leaves are crispy but not burned. Serve the kale chips with a side of ketch, sriracha, or your favorite salad dressing. Leftover kale chips don’t keep their crispiness very well, so these are best consumed immediately. I usually just leave them on the pan and pick away at them all day long.

name: Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Fingerling Potatoes and Rosemary

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 1/2 tsp Sucanat sugar or other granulated sugar
ingredients.name: Sucanat sugar or other granulated sugar

ingredients.rawIngredient: 3/4 tsp fine-grain sea salt, plus more if needed
ingredients.name: fine-grain sea salt, plus more if needed

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 tsp freshly ground black pepper, plus more if needed
ingredients.name: freshly ground black pepper, plus more if needed

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 400℉. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
Scrub the fingerling potatoes and pat them dry. Halve the potatoes lengthwise and place them in a very large bowl.

Trim the stem off the Brussels sprouts and remove loose leaves. Rinse the Brussels sprouts and pat them dry. Slice the Brussels sprouts in half through the stem end and place them in the bowl with the potatoes.

Add the garlic, rosemary, oil, sugar, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes (if using) and stir until the potatoes and Brussels sprouts are coated in the mixture. Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking sheet.

Roast for 35 to 38 minutes, stirring once halfway through the baking time, until the potatoes are golden and the Brussels sprouts are lightly charred. Season with more salt and pepper, if desired, and serve immediately.

name: Fall Harvest Butternut Squash with Almond-Pecan Parmesan

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 (2- to 3-pound) butternut squash, peeled and chopped
ingredients.name: butternut squash

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 cup fresh parsley leaves, finely chopped
ingredients.name: fresh parsley leaves

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 cup stemmed chopped lacinato kale leaves
ingredients.name: stemmed chopped lacinato kale leaves

preparationSteps: Make the squash: Preheat the oven to 400℉. Lightly oil a 2 1/2 to 3 quart casserole dish.

Peel the squash: Thinly slice off the bottom and top and then halve the squash lengthwise. Remove the seeds with a grapefruit spoon or ice cream scoop. Chop the squash into 1-inch chunks and place them in the casserole dish.
Add the garlic, parsley, oil, and salt and stir until well combined with the squash.
Cover the dish with a lid (or foil) and bake for 35 to 40 minutes, or until the squash is fork-tender.

Meanwhile, make the Almond-Pecan Parmesan: In a food processor, combine the almonds, pecans, nutritional yeast, oil, and salt and pulse until chunky (or simply chop the nuts by hand and mix everything together in a bowl).

When the squash is fork-tender, remove it from the oven and reduce the heat to 350℉. Carefully fold in the chopped kale and sprinkle the Almond-Parmesan all over the squash. Bake for 6 to 8 minutes more, uncovered, until the nuts are lightly toasted and the kale is wilted.

name: Super-Power Chia Bread

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 cup raw buckwheat groats (or more rolled oats)
ingredients.name: raw buckwheat groats (or more rolled oats)

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 tsp fine-grain sea salt, plus more if needed
ingredients.name: fine-grain sea salt, plus more if needed

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 325℉. Line a 9-inch square cake pan with two pieces of parchment paper, one going each way.
Place the oats and the buckwheat groats in a high-speed blender and blend on the highest speed until a fine flour forms.
In a large bowl, combine the oat and buckwheat flour, chia seeds, sunflower seeds, pepita seeds, oregano, sugar (if using), thyme, salt, garlic powder, and onion powder and stir until well combined.
Stir in 1 cup water until combined. The mixture will be very watery and runny.
Pour the mixture into the pan and spread it out evenly with a spatula. You cna use lightly wet hands to smooth it level, if necessary. Sprinkle the surface with some additional salt.

Bake, uncovered, for about 25 minutes, or until firm to the touch. Let the bread cool in the pan for 5 minutes and then transfer it to a cooling rack to cool for 5 to 10 minutes more. Slice and enjoy!

name: Cacao Crunch Almond Butter-Banana Bites

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 large bananas, peeled and sliced crosswise into 3/4-inch-wide pieces
ingredients.name: large bananas
ingredients.note: peeled and sliced crosswise into 3/4-inch-wide pieces

ingredients.rawIngredient: 3 tbsp roasted chunky almond butter or peanut butter
ingredients.name: roasted chunky almond butter or peanut butter

preparationSteps: Line a large plate with a piece of parchment paper. Place the sliced bananas on the parchment paper. Carefully spread 1/2 tsp of the almond butter on top of each banana piece.
Place the plate in the freezer to chill for at least 30 minutes, until the banana firms up.
In a small saucepan, gently melt the chocolate chips and oil together over very low heat. Stir to combine. With a small spoon, drizzle some of the melted chocolate on top of each banana piece.

Immediately sprinkle the banana pieces with the cacao nibs and almond slices and stick a toothpick in each (if desired). The melted chocolate will quickly harden up. If this doesn’t happen, simply place the plate back in the freezer for 5 to 10 minutes more, until the chocolate hardens.
Serve immediately. Store the leftovers in a container in the freezer. Partially thaw on the counter for a few minutes, before serving.

name: Peanut Butter Cookie Dough Bites

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 cup almond flour or almond meal
ingredients.name: almond flour or almond meal

preparationSteps: In a high-speed blender, blend the oats until a fine flour forms. Set aside.

In a large bowl, combine the oil, peanut butter, maple syrup, and vanilla and beat with a hand mixer until smooth. Add the almond flour, oat flour, and salt and beat again until combined. Fold in the chocolate chips.

Roll the dough into small balls (about 1 tbsp of dough each). If chocolate chips fall to the bottom of the bowl, press them back into the dough when rolling. Place the finished bites on a plate lined with parchment paper.
Freeze the bites for 5 to 10 minutes, or until firm. Store the bites in the freezer in a freezer bag for quick and easy snacks.

name: Chilled Chocolate-Espresso Torte with Toasted Hazelnut Crust
preparationSteps: Make the Toasted Hazelnut Crust: Preheat the oven to 350℉. Lightly grease a 9-inch pie dish with coconut oil.

In a food processor, process the hazelnuts into a fine crumb with the texture of sand. Add the oil, maple syrup, salt, and oat flour and process again until the dough comes together. Finally, add the rolled oats and pulse until the oats are chopped but still have some texture to them. The dough should stick together slightly when processed between your fingers, but it shouldn’t be super-sticky either. If it’s too dry, try adding 1 tsp water or processing a bit longer.

With your fingers, crumble the dough evenly over the base of the pie dish. Starting from the middle, press the mixture firmly and evenly into the dish, moving outward and upward along the side of the pie dish. The harder you press the crumbs into the dish, the better the crust will hold together. Poke a few fork holes into the bottom to let steam escape.
Bake the crust, uncovered, for 10 to 13 minutes., until lightly golden. Remove from the oven and set aside to cool on a rack for 15 to 20 minutes.

Make the filling: Drain and rinse the cashews. In a high-speed blender, combine the soaked cashews, maple syrup, cocoa powder, melted chocolate, vanilla, salt, and espresso powder (if using) and blend on high until the filling is completely smooth. It can take a few minutes of blending to get it smooth, depending on your blender. If the blender needs more liquid to get it going, add a tbsp of almond milk (or a bit more) to help it along.
Pour the filling into the prepared crust, scooping every last bit out of the blender. Smooth out the top evenly. Garnish with shaved chocolate and/or coconut flakes, if desired.

Place the pie dish on an even surface in the freezer, uncovered. Freeze for a couple of hours, and then cover the dish with foil and freeze overnight, or for a minimum of 4 to 6 hours, until the pie sets.

Remove the pie from the freezer and let it sit on the counter for 10 minutes before slicing. **This pie is meant to be served frozen.** Serve with homemade Whipped Coconut Cream and finely chopped hazelnuts, if desired, but it’s fantastic all on its own, too. Wrap leftover slices individually in foil and store them in an airtight container in the freezer for 1 to 1 1/2 weeks.

name: Mother Nature’s Apple Crumble
note: I like to use a variety of apples for the best flavor. I often use a mix of Honeycrisp, Granny Smith, and Gala apples with great results. This crumble works with other fruit, too, so use whatever is in season. Peaches and blueberries are a nice combo, although they produce a much juicer (and occasionally watery) crumble.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 6 to 7 heaping cups peeled and chopped baking apples (about 6 to 7 apples)
ingredients.name: heaping cups peeled and chopped baking apples (about 6 to 7 apples)

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/3 cup Sucanat sugar or other granulated sugar
ingredients.name: Sucanat sugar or other granulated sugar

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/3 cup almond flour or almond meal
ingredients.name: almond flour or almond meal

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 375℉. Lightly grease an 11 by 9-inch baking dish.

Make the apple filling: Place the apples in a large bowl and sprinkle the arrowroot powder on top. Toss until combined. Stir in the sugar, chia seeds, and cinnamon. Add the lemon juice and stir to combine. Pour the apple mixture into the prepared dish and smooth it out evenly.

Make the topping: In a large bowl (you can use the same one you used for the apples), stir together the oats, almonds, almond flour, maple syrup, melted coconut oil, shredded coconut (if using), cinnamon, and salt until thoroughly mixed.
Sprinkle the oat mixture all over the apple mixture in an even layer.

Cover the dish with foil and poke a couple of air holes in the foil. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes, until the apples are just fork-tender. Uncover the dish and bake for 10 to 15 minutes more, until the topping is golden and fragrant.

Serve with a scoop of dairy-free vanilla ice cream or Whipped Coconut Cream (see page 280). The leftovers are fantastic cold, straight from the fridge, or you can reheat it in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes. It’s healthy enough for breakfast the next day, too!

name: Fresh Fruit, Nuts & Whipped Coconut Cream
preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 300℉. Spread the nuts in a single layer on a rimmed baking sheet and toast them in the oven for 8 to 12 minutes, until lightly golden and fragrant.
Place a generous portion of fresh fruit in a small bowl or parfait glass. Add some Whipped Coconut Cream and top with a sprinkle of toasted nuts.

name: Gluten-Free Chocolate-Almond Brownies
note: If you don’t want to make gluten-free brownies, feel free to omit the brown rice flour and arrowroot powder and replace them with 3/4 cup unbleached all-purpose flour. Use the 1 cup almonds as stated in the recipe.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 cup + 2 tbsp vegan butter or coconut oil
ingredients.name: vegan butter or coconut oil

preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 350℉. Lightly oil a 9-inch square cake pan and line it with two pieces of parchment paper, one going each way.
In a small bowl, whisk together the flaxseed and 3 tbsp water and set aside.

In a blender or food processor, grind the almonds into a meal/flour. Sift out any large pieces. In a large bowl, whisk together the ground almonds, brown rice flour, arrowroot, cocoa powder, salt, and baking soda.

In a medium saucepan, melt 1/2 cup of the chocolate chips and the vegan butter over low heat. When two-thirds of the chips have melted, remove the pan from the heat and stir until smooth. Stir in the flaxseed mixture, sugar, almond milk, and vanilla until combined.
Pour the chocolate mixture over the ground almond mixture and stir well until there’s no flour on the bottom of the bowl. Fold in the walnuts, if desired, and the remaining 1/4 cup chocolate chips.
Spoon the batter into the prepared pan and place a parchment on top. Press down on the parchment paper with your hands to spread out the batter. Use a pastry roller to even it out, if desired.

Bake for 28 to 34 minutes. Let the brownies cool in the pan for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Do not remove the brownies untily they are completely cool or they will crumble. After cooling, slice the brownies into squares. The brownies will stay fresh in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

name: Homemade Yolos
note: If your dates are stiff or dry, soak them in water for 30 to 60 minutes to soften them before use. Drain them well and blot off excess water before processing. If you have leftover melted chocolate, scoop it onto a parchment paper-lined plate and freeze it. The chocolate will harden back up and you won’t have to throw any away. Break up the chocolate and store it for any other use.

ingredients.rawIngredient: Flaked sea salt or chia seeds (optional)
ingredients.name: Flaked sea salt or chia seeds (optional)

preparationSteps: Make the caramel: Process the pitted dates in a food processor until a sticky paste forms. Add the peanut butter and salt and process until combined. The mixture will be very sticky, but this is what we want.

Scoop the sticky mixture into a bowl and freeze, uncovered, for about 10 minutes. (Chilling makes the caramel easier to shape into balls.) Line a plate with parchment paper. Lightly wet your fingers and shape the chilled caramel into small balls, making about 20 balls total. Set the balls on the parchment paper-lined plate as you roll them. Place the finished balls in the freezer for 10 minutes to firm up.
Make the chocolate coating: In a small saucepan, melt the chocolate chips and oil over very low heat. When two-thirds of the chips have melted, remove the pan from the heat and stir until smooth.

Remove the caramel balls from the freezer and dunk each ball into the melted chocolate, one at a time. Roll them around with a fork to coat. Tap off any excess chocolate coating set the balls back on the lined plate. If desired, stick a toothpick in the top of each ball and sprinkle the balls with a tiny amount of flaked sea salt or chia seeds.
Freeze the balls for at least 20 minutes or until the chocolate has set. Yolos taste best straight from the freezer and will soften at room temp.

name: Sea Salt Caramel Coconut Ice Cream
note: Creamy, 7-ingredient coconut ice cream with a luxurious sea salt date caramel swirl! Naturally sweetened, so rich and satisfying, and ridiculously easy!

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 1/2 cups raw cashews ((soaked for 4-6 hours in cool water, or 1 hour in very hot water, then drained))
ingredients.name: raw cashews ((soaked for 4-6 hours in cool water, or 1 hour in very hot water, then drained))

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 15-ounce can full-fat coconut milk ((sub light with less creamy results))
ingredients.name: full-fat coconut milk ((sub light with less creamy results))

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 cup maple syrup or agave nectar ((sub up to half with cane sugar))
ingredients.name: maple syrup or agave nectar ((sub up to half with cane sugar))

ingredients.rawIngredient: 14 whole dates ((pitted // if dry, soak in warm water for 10 minutes, then drain))
ingredients.name: whole dates ((pitted // if dry, soak in warm water for 10 minutes, then drain))

preparationSteps: The night before, place your ice cream churning bowl in the freezer to properly chill. Also, make sure you soak your cashews overnight OR the next day for at least 6 hours. Be sure to drain before adding to blender.

Add soaked, drained cashews, coconut milk, coconut oil, maple syrup, vanilla and sea salt to a high speed blender and blend until creamy and smooth, scraping down sides as needed. Use the “liquify” setting if you have it. You want it to be completely creamy and blended.

TIP: For best texture, chill mixture for at least 4-6 hours or preferably overnight. If you're in a rush, pop it in the freezer for 1-2 hours before adding to ice cream maker. Otherwise, proceed without chilling - it will just take longer to churn and may require extra chilling (see next step).

Add chilled mixture to ice cream maker and churn according to manufacturer’s instructions - about 45 minutes. It should look like soft serve. If it wasn't chill enough, it may not firm up during the churning process. In that case, pop it back in the freezer (still in the churning bowl) and freeze until mostly firm. Then churn once more.

In the meantime, prepare caramel by adding dates to a food processor or blender and blending until creamy and smooth, adding warm water to encourage it along if it needs extra help. Season with sea salt (and bourbon if desired) and blend once more to combine. Taste and adjust flavor as needed. Set aside.

Once churned, transfer the ice cream to a large freezer-safe container and spoon in desired amount of caramel (I used it all, but you can reserve it for other uses) and use a spoon or knife to swirl. Add a pinch more salt for even more salty-sweet contrast if desired.
Smooth top and cover well. Freeze for at least 4-6 hours or until firm.
Set out for 10-15 minutes before serving to soften. Will keep for up to 1 week, though best when fresh.

name: Vegan Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Ice Cream
note: 10-ingredient MEGA creamy vegan ice cream loaded with peanut butter chocolate chip cookie dough! So creamy and decadent you'd never believe it was dairy- and egg-free.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 1/4 cups raw cashews ((soaked overnight // or at least 6 hours // then drained))
ingredients.name: raw cashews ((soaked overnight // or at least 6 hours // then drained))

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 cup agave nectar or maple syrup ((or honey if not vegan))
ingredients.name: agave nectar or maple syrup ((or honey if not vegan))

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 14-ounce can full-fat coconut milk ((reserve a little for the cookie dough))
ingredients.name: full-fat coconut milk ((reserve a little for the cookie dough))

ingredients.rawIngredient: 3 Tbsp vegan butter or coconut oil
ingredients.name: vegan butter or coconut oil

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/2 cup crunchy or creamy salted natural peanut butter ((I like Trader Joe's))
ingredients.name: crunchy or creamy salted natural peanut butter ((I like Trader Joe's))

ingredients.rawIngredient: 3/4 cup unbleached all-purpose flour ((you could sub a GF blend, but it will be slightly grainier in texture))
ingredients.name: unbleached all-purpose flour ((you could sub a GF blend, but it will be slightly grainier in texture))

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1/4 cup dairy-free mini chocolate chips ((such as Enjoy Life))
ingredients.name: dairy-free mini chocolate chips ((such as Enjoy Life))

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1-2 Tbsp coconut milk or other non-dairy milk
ingredients.name: coconut milk or other non-dairy milk

preparationSteps: The night before, place your ice cream churning bowl in the freezer to properly chill. Also, make sure you soak your cashews overnight OR the next day for at least 6 hours. Be sure to drain before adding to blender.

Add all ice cream ingredients to blender and blend until creamy and smooth, scraping down sides as needed. Use the “liquify” or "puree" setting if you have it. You want it to be completely creamy and blended.
Chill mixture in the freezer for 1.5-2 hours, or in the fridge overnight.

Add chilled mixture to ice cream maker and churn according to manufacturer’s instructions - about 45 minutes. It should look like soft serve. If for some reason it doesn't thicken enough, put the mixture (still in the ice cream churning bowl) and pop it back in the freezer to thicken before churning once more.

In the meantime, add vegan butter, peanut butter, brown sugar and vanilla to a mixing bowl and use a mixer or wooden spoon to combine. Add flour a little at a time and stir until thick and slightly crumbly. Add in a little coconut or other non-dairy milk to add moisture. Lastly, add chocolate chips and stir once more. Transfer to fridge or freezer to chill.
Once the ice cream is thick like soft serve, add in 3/4 of the cookie dough, crumbling it with your hands as you add it in.
Then transfer to a freezer-safe container and sprinkle in the last bits of cookie dough for extra texture. Cover well and freeze for at least 4-6 hours or until firm.
Set out for 15-20 minutes before serving to soften. Will keep for up to 1 week, though best when fresh.

name: Tahini Chocolate Banana Soft Serve
note: Insanely creamy and naturally sweetened banana soft serve infused with tahini paste and raw cacao powder! A healthier and delicious way to indulge in a plant-based dessert or snack.

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2 Tbsp tahini ((sesame seed paste // or sub other nut/seed butter // plus more for serving))
ingredients.name: tahini ((sesame seed paste // or sub other nut/seed butter // plus more for serving))

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1-2 Tbsp maple syrup ((or sub dates or other sweetener (i.e. stevia) to taste))
ingredients.name: maple syrup ((or sub dates or other sweetener (i.e. stevia) to taste))

preparationSteps: Add ripe, sliced, frozen bananas to a food processor or a high-speed blender and mix / blend until a creamy "soft serve" is formed, scraping down sides as needed - about 3-5 minutes.

Add tahini (or other nut/seed butter), cacao powder, and maple syrup and blend to combine. Then taste and adjust flavors as needed, adding more tahini for nuttiness, cacao for intense chocolate flavor, or maple syrup (or pitted dates) for sweetness. At this time, you can also add vanilla extract or a pinch of sea salt for more flavor. Mix as needed to combine.
Serve immediately or transfer to serving bowls and put in the freezer to thicken up. Serve as is or top with additional tahini or magic shell!
Best when fresh. Leftovers will keep in the freezer up to 1 week. Let come back to soft serve consistency at room temperature before enjoying.

name: Easy Lace Cookies
note: Made from only 6 ingredients, these lace cookies are ready in 30 minutes and they taste like sweet brown butter and caramel. Sandwich with a little chocolate for an extra special treat. Everyone loves these and they're gluten free too!

ingredients.rawIngredient: 2/3 cup (130g) packed light or dark brown sugar
ingredients.name: packed light or dark brown sugar

ingredients.rawIngredient: 1 Tablespoon (15ml) light or dark corn syrup or milk*
ingredients.name: light or dark corn syrup or milk*

ingredients.rawIngredient: optional: 1/2 cup Nutella or melted chocolate (see note)
ingredients.name: optional: 1/2 cup Nutella or melted chocolate (see note)

preparationSteps: Melt butter in a medium saucepan on medium heat. Once melted, add the brown sugar, almond flour, salt, and milk/corn syrup. Cook and whisk until sugar has dissolved and ingredients are completely combined, around 3 minutes.

Remove from heat and whisk in vanilla extract. Mixture will be grainy and shiny. Allow cookie dough to sit and thicken for about 5-10 minutes as the oven preheats. The mixture will thicken as it cools down.
Preheat oven to 350°F (177°C). Line 2-3 large baking sheets with parchment paper or silicone baking mats.

Drop scant teaspoonfuls of mixture 3 inches apart onto prepared baking sheets. Bake for 6-8 minutes until golden brown around the edges. The edges and centers will sizzle and bubble as the cookies bake!
Allow cookies to cool for 5 full minutes on the baking sheets before transferring to a rack to cool completely. Cookies dry and crisp up as they cool.

Once cool, enjoy cookies or sandwich with Nutella or melted chocolate. To sandwich, spread either Nutella or melted chocolate onto the bottom of one cooled cookie and sandwich with another. See recipe note if using chocolate.

Cookies without Nutella/chocolate filling will stay fresh covered at room temperature for 1 week. Cookies with Nutella/chocolate will stay fresh covered at room temperature for 3 days or in the refrigerator for 1 week.

name: Jalapeno Poppers
note: These easy jalapeno poppers are a game day favorite! Jalapenos are stuffed with a cheesy filling, topped with a buttery bread crumb topping and baked until golden.
preparationSteps: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Wearing gloves, slice the jalapenos in half lengthwise. Using a small spoon, scoop out the seeds and membranes.
In a bowl mix cream cheese, garlic powder, cheddar cheese and chives (if using).
In a separate bowl, combine Panko crumbs and melted butter.
Fill jalapenos with the cheese mixture. Top with crumbs.
Place on a baking pan and bake 18-22 minutes or until golden.
Cool 5-10 minutes before serving.
